# Volume 107: Date unknown (5 of 7) {.unnumbered}

## BH07665: Glorified art Thou, O Lord, Ruler of the nations… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His station!

Glorified art Thou, O Lord, Ruler of the nations, Who hast dawned from the horizon of immortality through Thy Most Great Name!

I beseech Thee by Thy greatness which hath encompassed all created things, and by Thy power which hath prevailed over all contingent beings, to ordain for Thy loved ones who have turned toward the Dayspring of Thy Revelation and entered the court of Thy Cause every good thing which Thou hast sent down in Thy Book and promised them in Thy Scriptures and Tablets. O my Lord! Make them steadfast in the path of Thy firm Command, and enable them to achieve what is best for them in this world and the next, O God of the worlds.

And strengthen them, O Creator of existence, through Thy all-embracing bounty extended over both the seen and unseen, for in Thy grasp are the reins of the world—Thou exaltest whomsoever Thou willest and ordainest for whomsoever Thou willest whatsoever Thou willest. Within Thy grasp is the kingdom of all things. Thou adornest whomsoever Thou willest with the raiment of glory and elevation, and Thou deckest whomsoever Thou pleasest with the vesture of grandeur and splendor.

There is no God but Thee, the King, the Almighty, the Self-Subsisting.

## BH07842: Praise be unto Thee, O Lord of the world!… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Bountiful, the All-Merciful

Praise be unto Thee, O Lord of the world! Bounty be unto Thee, O Possessor of existence! Glory be unto Thee, O Sovereign of bestowal! Laudation be unto Thee, O Desire of all beings! Light be unto Thee, O Speaker on Sinai! I beseech Thee by Thy most great signs and by the lights of Thy countenance, O Lord of the throne and of the earth, and by the Most Great Word through which all things have spoken, to bless that which Thou hast sent down from the heaven of Thy bounty and dispatched from the atmosphere of Thy loving-kindness, which Thou hast named through Thy might as a manifestation of Thy grace.

O Lord! We are Thy servants and Thy creation. We desire naught save the wonders of Thy grace, and we seek naught but what Thou hast ordained through the Pen of Thy decree and the Reed of Thy determination. O Lord! Illumine our hearts with the light of Thy knowledge, then make this newborn babe a blessing from Thee, a mercy from Thy presence, and a bounty from Thy side. Verily, Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Bounteous, the Most Generous, the Ancient Bestower.

## BH07875: This is a Book that speaketh with truth, wherein… {.unnumbered}

This is a Book that speaketh with truth, wherein are inscribed the mysteries of knowledge and wisdom, that perchance the people in the days of the Spirit may remember and that those who have answered the call of God and turned unto Him may be gladdened thereby, even they who hasten unto the fields of holiness.

Say: O people! Fear God and sow not corruption in the land of love. This is what teacheth you He Who is seated upon the preserved Tablets through the pen of the holy and beloved One. Make then your hearts as mirrors wherein may be reflected the mysteries of God, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Compelling, that ye may learn the ways of the Spirit and be guided by the guidance of God, and be of them that hasten unto the western horizon.

By God! This is a Book that summoneth all unto the shores of oneness, as they testify who enter within the precincts of their Lord's mercy. Thus have We taught you the ways of glory and revealed unto you the gems of wisdom, that perchance the people may return unto their native land in the canopy of holiness.

And the Spirit be upon thee and upon those who remember God with their tongues while in their hearts they remember Him at all times.

## BH07924: O thou who hast clung to the hem… {.unnumbered}

He is the One Who has power over whatsoever He wishes through His word "Be" and it is!

O thou who hast clung to the hem of My loving-kindness! Hearken unto My call from the direction of My grace—verily there is no God but Me, the Ordainer, the All-Knowing. We were with thee when thou didst journey from the land of Ta, turning toward the land of Kha. He, verily, is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. We have accepted thy work done for God's sake—rejoice thou in this and say: "Praise be to Thee, O God of all the worlds!" It behooveth thee to remember Me in the land of Ta with joy and fragrance. Thus doth the All-Merciful command thee from His glorious horizon.

Remind My servants with wisdom in such wise that their minds may be attracted and their hearts may be gladdened. This is indeed among the most meritorious deeds in the estimation of the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. I rejoice in My remembrance of thee and in that wherewith My Most Exalted Pen doth acquaint thee. He, verily, is the True One, the Faithful. God hath ordained for thee that which shall gladden the eyes of the believers. Glory be upon thee and upon those who have attained unto My days and have held fast unto My firm cord.

## BH07996: Glory be unto Thee, O God, for Thy Manifestation… {.unnumbered}

Glory be unto Thee, O God, for Thy Manifestation of Love to mankind! O Thou, who art our Life and Light, guide Thy servants to Thy Way, and make them rich in Thee and free from all save Thee.

O God, teach them Thy Oneness, and give unto them a realization of Thy Unity; that they may see no one save Thee. Thou art the Merciful and the Giver of Bounty!

O God, create in the hearts of Thy beloved the fire of Thy Love, that it may burn away the thought of everything save Thee.

Reveal unto them, O God, Thy Exalted Eternity; that Thou hast ever been and will always be, and that there is no God save Thee. Verily, in Thee will they find comfort and strength!

## BH07997: In Thy Name, the Sufficer, the Healer, the Fulfiller… {.unnumbered}

In Thy Name, the Sufficer, the Healer, the Fulfiller, the Loftiest, the Supreme, the Baha-El-Abha!

I ask Thee by Thine Ancient Beauty, and I supplicate Thee by the manifestation of Thy Greatest Majesty, and Thy Name, around which the heavens of the Manifestations revolve; by which the waters of the oceans overflow, the full moons appear, the lights diffuse, and verily, the visible and the invisible, the mysterious and the celebrated; by which all sorrow will be turned into joy and all disease will be turned into health, and by which every sick, afflicted, unfortunate and constrained one may be healed, to suffice to heal this weary, sick-worn one of the seen and the unseen disease.

Verily, Thou art the Powerful, the Conqueror, the Mighty, the Living, the Forgiver!

## BH11821: Glorified art Thou, O my God! At this hour… {.unnumbered}

Glorified art Thou, O my God! At this hour do I call upon Thee, at that moment whereon the Sun of Thy Lordship shone forth above the horizon of the heaven of the glory of Thy self-subsisting sovereignty, the Dove of the sanctity of Thy oneness warbled alone within the garden of the paradise of Thine eternity, and the lights of the glory of Thy absolute independence were lifted up into the atmosphere of fellowship with Thy lovers.

All praise be to Thee, O my God, inasmuch as Thou hast perfected Thy bounty unto the sincere among Thy servants and hast fulfilled Thy mercy toward such of Thy loved ones as have drawn nigh unto Thee. And when I beheld, O my God, that Thy favors had reached their utmost fullness and Thy loving-kindness had been made complete, I beseech Thee, by the mystery of Thy Name through which all contingent things have struck root and by which the robe of glory hath been arrayed upon the temple of all created things, to bestow upon this handmaid that which shall rejoice her heart, tranquillize her mind, and bring rest unto her soul.

Then shall her eyes be solaced through those exalted blessings which Thou hast ordained for her. Thou art, verily, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Ancient of Days.

## BH08224: This is a day of joy and delight… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Commanding, the All-Wise

This is a day of joy and delight—joy from what? From the wine of divine love. In this luminous morn thou hast indeed drunk thereof through His remembrance and His wondrous Name. Thou hast ever been mentioned, and wilt continue to be mentioned, in the gathering of lovers, and it is observed that throughout all regions thy mention is exalted. Rejoice thou in this word which no possession of kings can equal—to this doth this Truthful, this Faithful One bear witness.

Be not grieved by events. Soar with the wings of detachment in this atmosphere. Verily He will assist thee and aid thee through His power and sovereignty. He is the Almighty, the All-Powerful. Preserve what hath been revealed unto thee at this time, then give thanks unto God, thy Lord and the Lord of the mighty Throne. Peace and glory be upon thee and upon those with thee and upon every steadfast, firm and faithful one.

## BH08516: O people of the earth! Abandon what ye possess… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him Who is the All-Powerful, the Supreme Protector of the world

O people of the earth! Abandon what ye possess, for He hath come with manifest sovereignty. Nothing shall profit you today save through His bidding, the Mighty, the Wondrous. The world hath been adorned with His Most Great Name. Blessed is he who hath turned towards Him, and woe betide them that have turned away! This is He Who was promised unto you in the Books of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Ponder, O people, then read what We have sent down in truth. Verily it guideth you unto My Straight Path. Hold fast unto the cord of your Lord's loving-kindness and abandon that which ye were commanded by every ignorant doubter. By God's life! Those who lay claim to knowledge are in manifest error. The ocean of knowledge hath surged before your eyes. Turn ye towards it by the command of God, the Single, the All-Informed. He will aid you even as He aided His loved ones before you, and will ordain for you that which no reckoner, however learned, can reckon.

## BH08564: O Attar and O son of Attar! This name… {.unnumbered}

O Attar and O son of Attar! This name must be a sweet, precious and highly fragrant testimony, so that it may be diffused throughout the realm of utterance and meaning and guide the heedless unto the oceans of awareness....

Husayn Effendi, upon him be My glory, was the bearer of the letter. In truth, the honored Name of God and the others of that household constantly make mention of you. Well was it said: "Sweet is the remembrance of loved ones by their beloved." O Attar! Beseech God, exalted be His glory, to adorn the people of God with the manners of the dwellers of the Crimson Ark. He is the Powerful, the Mighty....

## BH08588: O Muhammad-Qablil-Husayn! Today is the day of acceptance… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, Speaking Witness

O Muhammad-Qablil-Husayn! Today is the day of acceptance and turning to God and of mention and praise and service. May you be fresh and verdant through the springtime breezes of God and speak forth in remembrance of the Beloved of the worlds. I swear by the Sun of the horizon of manifestation that one mention today is more glorious in the sight of God than the mention of a multitude of people occurring in days other than these. Hold fast to the cord of thy Lord's loving-kindness and place thy trust in Him. Verily He aids whomsoever He willeth through a command from His presence, and He is the All-Bountiful, the Generous.

Beseech God, exalted be His glory, that He may protect thee and the people of that land from the cawing of the crows and the clamor of the liars and deceivers. Verily He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. We send from this spot Our greetings upon thee and upon My loved ones who responded when they heard My wondrous, mighty Call.

## BH08449: Thy letter was present before My countenance and what… {.unnumbered}

In the name of the Friend

Thy letter was present before My countenance and what was written therein was observed. Praise the Beloved of the worlds that thou hast attained unto the recognition of His Self and drunk from His Kawthar of "Am I not?" God willing, thou must at all times be engaged in the remembrance of the All-Merciful and detached and free from aught else. Thou hast attained unto the Most Great Pilgrimage and arrived at the Most Great Scene and hearkened unto the melody of the All-Merciful from the right hand of the Throne. God willing, thou must conduct thyself with godly attributes so that all may inhale from thee the fragrances of sanctity and holiness, inasmuch as thou hast entered the House and become aware, according to thy capacity, of the sanctity and holiness of the Lord of the House. God willing, through the loving-kindness of the All-Merciful, thou shalt at all times drink from the Kawthar of love and be sustained by the fruits of the Tree of Ridvan. And the glory be upon thee.

## BH08422: Whatsoever God hath willed, verily He shall manifest it… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory, the Most Great, the Most High

Whatsoever God hath willed, verily He shall manifest it in truth, and it is best for Us and for such of His servants as draw nigh unto Him. And He, verily, is the Ruler over whatsoever He willeth. Through their oppression the countenance of justice hath been illumined, yet they remain in wondrous stupor. That which they have wrought shall cause you no harm, for He is the Mighty, the All-Bestowing.

We have enjoined wisdom solely due to the weakness of some, while others possess might and power. These latter are not saddened by anything, nor are they hindered by any matter. Thus hath the decree been ordained in the Book. It behooveth thee to bid the loved ones to observe wisdom under all conditions. This is what beseemeth most of the loved ones. We have informed thee of this on the night when thou wert present before the Countenance. Thy Lord, verily, is the Mighty, the All-Knowing. My Splendor be upon thee, O Muhammad, and My remembrance be upon thee, O Mustafa. Thou art among those who have borne the Trust and sacrificed thyself in the path of God, the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting.

## BH08468: In My Name which shineth forth from the horizon… {.unnumbered}

In My Name which shineth forth from the horizon of the heaven of bounty.

This is a Book from Us unto the Leaf of the Divine Lote-Tree, a grace from Our presence and a mercy from before Us. Blessed is he who hath heard and attained, and woe unto the heedless. O My Leaf and O My Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness and My mercy. Say:

Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having given me to drink, from the hand of Thy bounty, the Kawthar of Thy knowledge. And unto Thee be glory and favor, for having caused me to dwell near unto Thee and having made me to hear Thy call. My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy most great signs and by Thy mercy which hath preceded all things, to ordain for me what Thou hast ordained for Thy handmaidens who circle round the throne of Thy grandeur. O Lord! Withhold not from Thy handmaiden the wonders of Thy generosity and favor, and the gems of Thy bounty and bestowals. Thou art, verily, the Most Merciful of the merciful ones and the Fulfiller of the needs of them that supplicate Thee. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Bountiful, the All-Forgiving, the Merciful.

## BH08479: To be typed {.unnumbered}

To be typed.

## BH08576: O Ghaffar! When thou hast received the Tablet… {.unnumbered}

He is the One Who rules over all names!

O Ghaffar! When thou hast received the Tablet of thy Lord, the Unconstrained, arise and say:

My God, my God! I testify that Thou hast appeared and revealed that which lay hidden in Thy knowledge and treasured within the repositories of Thine infallibility. I beseech Thee by the breathings of Thy Revelation in Thy days and the manifestations of Thy power in Thy lands to ordain for me through Thy Most Exalted Pen that which shall profit me in the world to come and in this life. O my Lord! Thou knowest what I possess while I know not what Thou possessest. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

I implore Thee, O my God and God of earth and heaven, to cause my will to be wholly merged in Thy Will, and my desire to be completely submerged in Thy Desire, that I may will naught except what Thou hast willed for me through Thy bounty, and seek naught save what Thou hast ordained for me through Thy grace. Verily Thou art the One with power over whatsoever Thou pleasest. There is none other God but Thee, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting.

## BH08488: O Ibrahim! Praise be to God, thou hast been… {.unnumbered}

In the name of the All-Knowing Bestower!

O Ibrahim! Praise be to God, thou hast been and art beneath the glance of divine favor. In days when the peoples of the world turned away, thou didst turn toward Him and didst drink the choice wine of recognition from the cup of bounty of the Lord of Religions. Well is it with thee and happy art thou! We beseech God to assist thee even as He assisted thy father and thine uncle. By the life of God! Ye are all remembered in the presence of the Wronged One and have attained to the grace of God. Say:

My God, my God! Adorn my heart with the ornament of Thy love, my tongue with Thy remembrance and praise, mine eye with beholding Thy horizon, and my face with turning toward the lights of Thy countenance. O Lord! I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy knowledge and the sun of Thy grace to aid me in all conditions to be steadfast in Thy Cause. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is no God but Thee, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH08374: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O God of all… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him Who shineth from the horizon of the world!

Say: Praise be unto Thee, O God of all beings and Educator of all created things, for having caused me to hear Thy most sweet call and shown me the surging waves of the ocean of Thy utterance, O Lord of all men, and guided me to Thy straight path, and illumined my heart with the light of Thy mighty announcement whereby the limbs of the ungodly who denied Thy manifestation and broke Thy covenant and disputed Thy signs were made to tremble.

O my Lord! I am Thy servant, acknowledging Thy oneness and singleness and that which Thou hast sent down in Thy Book. I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and the mysteries of the ocean of Thy knowledge to confirm me in such steadfastness as shall not be prevented by the doubts of the learned nor the signs of the divines nor the power of rulers. Verily Thou art the Almighty Whom the happenings of the world cannot weaken, nor the clamor of the nations. There is none other God but Thee, the Strong, the Dominant, the Powerful.

## BH08000: From every quarter the smoke of rancour and oppression… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the one peerless and incomparable God

From every quarter the smoke of rancour and oppression hath been raised, and upon the earth there hath come to pass that which, from the beginning of the world until now, hath had neither like nor peer.

Glorified be God! His Majesty the King perceiveth not what hath been, and what still is, the cause of the patience and long-suffering of the loved ones of God. The greatest cause of restraint for the Lord of Eternity and His irrevocable decree hath verily been this: can it be that, in the eyes of them who are nigh unto God and wholly devoted unto Him, any excellence should be ascribed unto the ravening beasts of the world? Nay, by God Himself, Who overshadoweth all that are in the heavens and on the earth!

Blessed art thou, inasmuch as thy name hath been mentioned before the Countenance, and there hath been revealed for thee that which shall endure so long as the names of thy Lord, the Forgiving, the Merciful, shall endure. The glory that shineth forth from the horizon of the heaven of My mercy rest upon thee and upon all them that love thee for the sake of God, the Mighty, the All-Praised.

## BH08217: The Most Great Remembrance calleth all who are… {.unnumbered}

The Most Great Remembrance calleth all who are in the realm of being unto God, the Lord of all religions, saying: We have raised Him up in the temple of man. Exalted be the All-Merciful, Who hath ordained every matter in the Book.

That which was hidden hath now been made manifest, and that which lay concealed in the Tablets hath been brought forth. Say: The horizon of utterance hath been illumined by the sun of My Name, the One Who holdeth dominion over all who are on earth and in the heavens. By the life of God! We have not failed in remembrance and exposition, yet the people remain wrapt in delusion and veiled from the truth.

Shouldst thou attain unto this Tablet, arise to serve thy wronged Lord, He through Whom most of those upon earth were thunderstruck and the mountains were laid low. Make mention of thy Lord according to that which God hath taught thee as a bounty from His presence. He, verily, is the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

Glory rest upon the people of Bahá, whom He hath mentioned unto God in the Book with the fairest of remembrances.

## BH08129: O people who have gone to the pilgrimage, where… {.unnumbered}

O people who have gone to the pilgrimage, where are you, where are you?

The Beloved is right here, come hither, come hither!

This, however, is the city of the Beloved, unburdened by name and fame. This is the path of lovers where even the guide wanders bewildered. This is the sacred sanctuary where the pilgrim's garb of all save Him betokens lack of certitude. This is the Throne of the All-Merciful, not a place for bearing the temple of the Qur'an. If thou seekest the Friend, free thyself from the veil of fancy and intimacy with strangers. If thou seekest the light of the Sun of the Beloved, cease circling around the light of the candle. And when the mirage of fancy and imagination hath sufficed thee in place of the sweet waters of Beauty, seek not to soar with those who wing their flight in the atmosphere of love, nor desire companionship with those who have laid down their lives at the gallows of extinction....

## BH08001: The items and materials which ye sent have been… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty, the Beloved.

The items and materials which ye sent have been received and observed. May God graciously bestow His recompense. May He grant a perfect reward unto the receiver, the bearer, the seamstress, the embroiderer, and unto all without exception. Yet that which is the very essence, the very root of love and loyalty, this thou didst not perform; whatsoever else thou hast done pertaineth but to the branches. The root is thy coming in person, that they who wait may be delivered from their waiting, and that this goodly matter may be brought unto its consummation.

In very truth, all who are numbered among the friends must exert their utmost endeavour in works of charity and benevolence. Be that as it may, thy coming is needful. Should the cold prove an obstacle, let them bring a carriage. To all we convey our loving greetings. If thou hast kerchiefs, cloth, poetry, or the like, bring them all with thee. Gawhar, God willing, is gladdened. Let Shu'a' Effendi also come today, if it be possible.

## BH08067: O Pen of the Cause! Clothe the meanings… {.unnumbered}

O Pen of the Cause! Clothe the meanings in the garment of words, then reveal them in the temple of letters, that haply those who contend, arrayed in the vestures of names and attributes, may come forth from their vain imaginings and recognize the Lord of lords—in these days when the sun of all horizons hath been eclipsed behind the veil of these wicked ones who have protested and been numbered with the idolaters, as recorded upon guarded tablets of glory.

O Ibrahim! When My first Friend [Abraham] heard of My calamity, he delivered himself into the fire. Do thou, then, cast thyself into the fire of separation, out of longing for My beauty, that thou mayest be of those who, in separation, remain patient through My grace.

And I counsel thee, O servant, not to consort with those in whose hearts is hatred for the Youth, though they should lavish upon thee the treasures of the heavens and the earth and the hidden stores of the unseen.

## BH08140: Regarding what you wrote about Jinab Aqa Mirza Muhsin… {.unnumbered}

Regarding what you wrote about Jinab Aqa Mirza Muhsin, upon him be 9 66 [Baha'u'llah], after being submitted to the Most Holy and Exalted Presence, this prayer was revealed from the heaven of divine will:

O my God, my God! Thou seest me and hearest my cry and the yearning of my heart. I beseech Thee by the glances of the eyes of Thy loving-kindness not to deprive me of the fragrances of Thy remembrance in Thy days. O my Lord! I have turned with my whole being to Thy horizon, and mine eyes are fixed in expectation of the wonders of Thy mercy, and my heart is turned toward the heaven of Thy bounty. I beseech Thee by the Word through which Thou didst create all beings and didst manifest all existence to send down upon me from the clouds of Thy gifts that which will profit me in Thy worlds. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful Whom neither the conditions of creation nor the clamor of those who have denied Thee and Thy signs hath frustrated. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH08149: After praising the Lord—exalted be His mention—we inquire after… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing

After praising the Lord—exalted be His mention—we inquire after the condition of all, and especially of Mahd-i-‘Ulya.

And further, O My Branch: send the new fur-lined cloak. To continue wearing this old ʿaba hath become a most senseless ordeal. At all times it requireth a bearer or an attendant to be on hand, so that the moment it falleth to pieces in the course of coming or going, he may forthwith patch it together again with the help of glue. According to what hath been recounted in the books, the wool of this cloak went aboard the Ark with the prophet Noah; ere that, it came down from the highest Paradise with Adam, the Father of Mankind. It was with Moses on Sinai, and kept company with the Spirit [Jesus]. In short, its full story cannot be recounted by the Pen. In the words of the late Alusi: "Ancient—ancient indeed!"

Glory be upon you, and upon him who loveth you and serveth you for the sake of God, the Lord of the mighty Throne.

## BH08151: Say to the divines on behalf of Baha: You… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the one God!

Say to the divines on behalf of Baha: You have deemed Us guilty. What was the guilt of the Primal Point—may the spirit of all else but Him be sacrificed for Him—that made Him the target of your bullets? What manifest guilt had the Primal Point committed against the Seal of the Prophets—may the spirit of all worlds be sacrificed for Him—that ye convened a council to arrange for His execution? What guilt and calumny was evident from Christ against the Seal of the Prophets that you crucified Him? According to your vain belief, Christ was false to Moses—what falsehood and calumny was apparent that you testified to His falsehood? According to your vain belief, Moses was false and guilty against Abraham—what guilt was manifest that you cast Him into the fire? If you say "We are not those people," We say your words are the same words and your deeds are the same deeds. And peace be upon whoever follows guidance.

## BH08152: By Thy light, O God; by Thy Name, O… {.unnumbered}

By Thy light, O God; by Thy Name, O God; by Thy command, O God; by Thy sovereignty, O God; by Thy glory, O God; by Thy might, O God; by Thy bounty, O God; by Thy verses, O God; by Thy power, O God; by Thy greatness, O God; by Thy path, O God; by Thy Balance, O God; by Thy Manifestation, O God; by Thine irresistible dominion, O God; by Thy gifts, O God; by Thy turning in grace, O God; by Thy generosity, O God; by Thy munificence, O God; by Thy succour, O God; by Thy victory, O God—I beseech Thee to exalt Thy glory among Thy creatures, and to aid it through the standards of Thy might and the signs of Thy greatness.

O Lord! Thou seest him amid the wicked of Thy creation. I entreat Thee by Thine All-Great Announcement and by Thy Ancient Name to ordain for him who hath ascended Thy Throne the good of every world among Thy worlds.

## BH08167: O distinguished Name of God! Upon thee be… {.unnumbered}

He is God, the Most Exalted.

O distinguished Name of God! Upon thee be the glory of God. In accordance with the former spoken and written word, the present servant raised aloft the banner of fulfillment, discharged his obligation, and remained faithful unto his covenant. And since a portion of the bounties that lay before Us was taken for that honored one and sent forth, do thou also distribute thereof, after taking for thyself thine own share, which is the loftiest portion.

Praised be God, thou hast ever been, and still art, remembered. Thou hast endured with a patience meet and seemly that thou mightest divide among men that which sufficeth them, even the splendor shining from the horizon of the heaven of My grace.

Upon thee be the glory of God, and upon those who are with thee, and upon whoso hath sought guidance through the peerless nature of thy utterance and through the remembrance of thee.

## BH08186: Thou hadst made mention, on the authority of Mirza… {.unnumbered}

He is God, the Builder, the All-Knowing.

Thou hadst made mention, on the authority of Mirza Ḥusayn and Haji—upon them be the Baha of God—of the house and of its sale. This matter thou thyself shouldst inquire of him, that it may become clear what the honored persons have said, and what their intention hath been, so that Jinab-i-Mirza may act with insight.

Houses, their builders, and their destroyers all return unto the dust. The kingdom belongeth unto God, the One, the Single, the All-Informed. The true Sovereign possesseth not now a throne, nor hath the Builder of the world a house. Some imagine that the well-known inhabited House is specially set apart for God—glorious is His majesty—but in truth that too was built in heaven, not on earth. Verily, the Throne is beneath Him, and the House belongeth unto another than Him, while the command is His alone. He doeth whatsoever He willeth, and ordaineth whatsoever He pleaseth. He is the One, the Single, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH08411: A missive from the Wronged One to him who… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Holy, the Most Great, the Most Ancient, the Most Generous

A missive from the Wronged One to him who desires to turn towards the sublime and most exalted Horizon and hear the Call of God, the Lord of Names, that it may draw him to the station which God hath mentioned in a preserved Tablet. O servant! Hearken unto the Call from the direction of thy Lord, the Most High. He verily speaketh the truth: There is no God but Him, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Be steadfast in the Cause of thy Lord, forsake all else and take what thou art commanded by Him. He is verily the All-Bountiful, the Ancient of Days. Beware lest things prevent thee from the Creator of heaven or the clamor of the heedless turn thee aside from the Path. Hold fast to the hem of thy Lord's mercy and say:

O God of the world! I beseech Thee by the Most Great Name to make me in all conditions one who uttereth Thy praise, who taketh refuge in Thy presence, who seeketh protection at Thy threshold, who remaineth firm in Thy love and steadfast in Thy Cause. Thou art He Who doeth what He willeth through His sovereignty. The hosts of the world and the concourse of nations cannot withhold Thee. Thou art verily the Almighty, the Exalted, the Powerful, the Omnipotent.

## BH08427: Be not grieved at anything. We beseech God… {.unnumbered}

Be not grieved at anything. We beseech God to make the crescent moon of thy hope into a full moon, and the star of thy desire into a radiant sun. He is, verily, the Protector of the sincere ones. Say: He Who hath come was promised in the Book and mentioned in hearts and minds. Those who turned away from Him turned away from the Hidden Mystery and the Treasured Name, but they understand not. When the Dawn of Manifestation unfurled His banner, the people arose in opposition. Among them were those who said He came to corrupt the world. Say: Nay, by God, rather for its reformation, did ye but know! Even were My corruption better than your reformation, by God, My oppression would be better than the justice of the world, and My death the cause of life for the nations, would ye but understand! Say: Though the outward appearance of My oppression be as fire, yet its inner reality is light. Fear God, O people, and say not that which ye know not.

## BH08455: Yea, excellent is that which he hath done, excellent… {.unnumbered}

Yea, excellent is that which he hath done, excellent that which he hath spoken, and blessed his meeting with them.

O My Name! I have created thee for remembrance and praise, for fellowship and for attaining My presence. God willing, the parched lands, through the showers of utterance, shall be drawn by the adornment of new growth, and shall attain unto their victory. For within My utterance there lieth concealed a mighty power, and within it are treasured diverse manifestations; and in one station it is water itself. In another station it is fire, inasmuch as it giveth to drink, and draweth the chilled hearts unto warmth, that true moderation may be made manifest.

We have made mention of every name that was in thy book, with a remembrance whereby the remembrances did circle and the traces did revolve. Blessedness for thee and for them, and for whoso uttereth a word, as a bounty from His presence; and for whoso writeth before His face. It is ended.

## BH08493: O Asad! Upon thee be My peace! A ray… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted is He!

O Asad! Upon thee be My peace! A ray of My loving-kindness is present, and from the Ocean of the bounty of God, exalted be His glory, he hath beseeched pearls of wisdom and utterance. His request hath been granted, and from the mighty treasury which lay concealed and hidden within the Most Exalted Pen there hath appeared that which the treasuries of kings and the riches of earth cannot equal. O Asad! God willing, thou shalt appear even as a lion in the jungle of divine power and shalt, through wisdom and utterance, deliver the servants from the doubts and allusions of the Shi'ihs of Iran, that all may turn with detached hearts, pure souls, expanded breasts, penetrating vision and radiant countenance unto the light of His Face, and drink from the Euphrates of the All-Merciful's mercy which floweth from the right hand of God's throne. Blessed are they that drink thereof, and woe unto the heedless!

## BH08519: O people of the household! Upon you be… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

O people of the household! Upon you be the peace of God and His mercy. Great indeed hath been the labor ye have borne; your deed is accepted and your endeavor is appreciated. Convey greetings unto all: the Afnan, the members of the household of Haji, the circumambulants, the kindred, and those who are with you. May God—glorious is His majesty—bestow His reward upon them all: upon the men and women who arose to serve, upon the servants and handmaidens, upon those who gave to eat and those who partook, and upon those who gave to drink and those who drank—that is, sherbet of lemon-water and the like.

In brief, the rock candy that was sent, together with a bottle of perfume, should be forwarded to the Afnan. As for the page which bore the authorization and the instructions, its original issued from the Pen of the Wronged One; the Most Great Branch copied it therefrom. We shall give that also to Furugh. Whatsoever proceedeth from Him is beloved.

Glory be upon him who appeared, and upon you, and upon every steadfast and upright soul.

## BH08558: O young in years yet great in station!… {.unnumbered}

O young in years yet great in station! In thy childhood thou hast attained to a station wherein the Lord of all beings maketh mention of thee. Blessed art thou, and blessed is thy father who hath attained unto the recognition of God, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

Say: O my God, and my Lord, and my Creator, and my Master! I beseech from the ocean of Thy bounty that Thou wouldst cause this tender sapling in the garden of Thy love to drink from the living waters, and protect it from the autumn winds. Thou art the Powerful, Thou art the All-Knowing. O my God! I have turned to Thee and make mention of Thee, and through the blessedness of Thy Name am I freed and detached from all else. O God! We are looking unto Thee and we beseech Thee to manifest through us that which is worthy of Thee. The days are Thine. Thou art the Bestower, the Bountiful One.

## BH08575: O Branch of Baha! Upon thee be My glory… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty.

O Branch of Baha! Upon thee be My glory. God willing, through the enduring sovereignty of earth and heaven, thou shalt abide beneath the shadow of the favor of the true Beloved.

Thy letter was received. Praise be to God, Who hath opened the gate of bounty and lavished the blessings of divine unity upon the people of sincerity and faithfulness. Exalted be His grace, and exalted be His bestowal. Let them pitch the tent, but unanimity is not permitted, and such a gathering is not accepted. Glory be to God! It would seem that some few of the friends have become troubled; yet the honored representatives are assured, and do not regard these wronged ones as sowers of mischief.

We make mention of Her Holiness the Mahd-i-ʿUlya and those with her. Badi' Effendi, in the wondrous cities and lands, God willing, is kept safe.

Peace be upon you, and upon your first and your last, your outward and your inward. Haydar is also remembered.

## BH08606: O Mahd-i-‘Ulya! Upon thee be the Glory of God… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

O Mahd-i-‘Ulya! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of humankind. God willing, thy condition is good. We beseech God that He may heal thee through His bounty and strengthen thee unto that which beseemeth His days. Verily, He is the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

We summoned the Afnan; as for the rest, send whomever thou deemest advisable. Khanum also hath permission. In view of Janab-i-Afnan-i-Kabir, it would be preferable and more fitting that Furugh remain where she is for the present. As for Gawhar Khanum, "Malik al-Kaftar" is meaningless. Surely she desireth to attain the presence. Jinabih-i-Validih likewise hath certainly been, and still is, intent upon attaining presence and reunion.

We make mention of the children. His Holiness Amin, Janabih-i-Zarrin-Kiz, and Musa Effendi have arrived. Husayn Effendi, Ruhiyyih Khanum, and the others among the ladies of dignity and grandeur—I convey greetings unto them all, and announce unto them the glad tidings of divine favor. Verily, He is the Forgiving, the Generous.

## BH08607: O Nabil! Upon thee be the Baha of God… {.unnumbered}

O Nabil! Upon thee be the Baha of God, the Mighty, the Beauteous.

The Most Great Glad-Tidings is this: that the words,

> "but He is the Messenger of God and the Seal of the Prophets,"

have reached their consummation in the Day whereon mankind shall arise before the Lord of all worlds. This glad-tiding hath had, and hath, no likeness and no peer. Yet the party of the Shi'ah remaineth in grievous drunkenness.

We beseech God that He may, through His Name, exalt His servants, and that He may ordain for thee the recompense of attaining His presence throughout the ages and the centuries. Verily, He is the Powerful, the All-Choosing.

On Tuesday the ruling became final. Blessed art thou. The honored Haji—upon him be the Baha of God and His mercy—is remembered and hath attained unto grace. Unto all who dwell in that house, men and women, young and old alike, We send greetings, and We give them glad tidings of the lights of the eternal bestowal.

Baha be upon thee from God, the Lord of all worlds.

## BH08609: O Nur! Upon thee be the peace… {.unnumbered}

O Nur! Upon thee be the peace of the Wronged One.

We have informed thee of one matter and have announced unto thee glad-tidings of another. The first hath come to pass, and thou hast witnessed the second. Know thou, with the knowledge of certitude, that the lands shall not be stilled save through making amends for that which they have wrought without clear proof from God, the Lord of all the worlds. The appointed term of the commander, the saintly one, hath been fulfilled, and the heart hath been rent; yet the Cause is in the hand of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

And in this hour We give thee another glad-tiding: that since His Majesty the Sultan hath held fast unto that which is right and hath spent his comfort for the uplifting of the Word of unity, God will surely aid him, and his condition shall not be altered.

We beseech God, exalted be He, to strengthen him to serve His Faith, to assist him with the hosts of heaven and earth, and to ordain for him the good of the life to come and of this first life below. Verily, He is the Lord of all mankind and the Lord of the Throne and of the dust. There is none other God but He, the Hearer, the Answerer, and worthy of answering.

## BH11664: In My Name, the One dawning from the horizon… {.unnumbered}

In My Name, the One dawning from the horizon of heaven!

O ʿAziz! Praise God for having enabled thee to attain the presence of Him Who was hidden within God's knowledge and inscribed in the Books of the Messengers. Behold the loving-kindness of God and His mercy. He beareth witness from His most exalted horizon to thy glory, thy turning towards Him, and thy dedication on a Day whereon the foundations of every doubter were shaken. Rejoice that thy glory hath been mentioned at the Praiseworthy Spot and hath flowed from the Pen of thy Lord, the Almighty, the Powerful. We have forsaken mention of the glory of the glorious ones in this outer world and have instead mentioned thy glory in such wise as shall endure throughout the eternity of My mighty, invincible Kingdom. Blessed is the glory confirmed by My Most Exalted Pen; naught else is mentioned before thy Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Thus did the Tongue of Grandeur speak when He entered the garden at this radiant dawn. Glory be upon thee and upon all who are steadfast and firm.

## BH11547: Even this much that has been mentioned was solely… {.unnumbered}

Even this much that has been mentioned was solely to establish proof, so that they might realize at least this much—that this earth will never be devoid of a manifest proof, and what prevents its manifestation and appearance in this age and era are the evil souls of the people.

And as for making this noble science a criterion—since in other sciences the door of dispute remains open and the crookedness of people's natures is evident, while this noble science leads to direct experience and witnessing, and inevitably distinguishes truth from falsehood, even though these deniers are such that "if they should see every sign, they would not believe in it" and would say "this is but evident sorcery."

## BH11896: O Jamaliyyih! Upon thee be the glory of God… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed

O Jamaliyyih! Upon thee be the glory of God and His favors and bounty. I bear witness that thou hast attained the presence before My face and hast been successful in serving Me throughout the nights and days, such that neither did weariness overtake thee in the service of thy Lord, nor did any circumstance prevent thee from serving Me and standing before My countenance. Rejoice in the testimony of My Most Exalted Pen and say:

> "Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name, glory be unto Thee, O my God, by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued the kingdom of earth and heaven and manifested thereby the mysteries of the realm of power, to assist me to be steadfast in Thy love and Thy remembrance and Thy Cause. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the All-Merciful."

The glory from Our presence be upon thee, O My handmaiden and My leaf and one who circled round Me in the evening and at dawn, and upon every handmaiden who hath attained to this mighty and wondrous Cause and who hath, for the sake of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy, observed thy station.

## BH09131: O ʿAbdu'l-Husayn, upon thee be My Glory! Thy letter… {.unnumbered}

He is the Hearer, the Answerer!

O ʿAbdu'l-Husayn, upon thee be My Glory! Thy letter was received and considered. We heard thy call and have responded with this most exalted, most holy Tablet. Say:

My God, my God! Thou seest Thy servant turning toward Thee, facing the lights of Thy countenance, holding fast to the cord of Thy bounty, and clinging to the hem of Thy mercy. I beseech Thee by Thy greatest signs, Thy mighty announcement and Thy ancient Cause, to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee and profit me in Thy worlds. Verily Thou knowest my poverty, my want, my distress and my lowliness, and what I have and what I know not of what Thou hast. Thou art verily the All-Powerful, the All-Merciful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. The Glory from Us be upon thee and upon thy mother and upon thy sisters and upon every maidservant who hath attained in the days of God, the Lord of all worlds.

## BH08905: The Day of God hath come, which Moses… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing Speaker.

The Day of God hath come, which Moses the Interlocutor foretold, and after Him the Spirit (Christ), and after Him Muhammad the Apostle of God through His words "The Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds." O Abdul-Husayn! Upon thee be My peace and My glory. Should anyone ask thee about the Glory (Baha), say: He is beneath the claws of hatred. Blessed art thou, for God hath made thee the bearer of tidings of the two Luminaries imprisoned without any proof from God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

The Glory and the Light shining from the horizon of Revelation be upon thee and upon them and upon every steadfast and firm one, and upon every resolute and trustworthy one. Gladden those bearing the name of Jud through the remembrance of God, exalted be His glory. We beseech God to preserve them and aid them through His sovereignty. Verily He is the Powerful, the Almighty.

## BH09106: In My Most Ancient, Most Glorious Name {.unnumbered}

In My Most Ancient, Most Glorious Name

O thou Leaf, the crimson Leaf! Rejoice in that thy Best-Beloved, the All-Glorious, remembereth theea€"He, the Wronged One Who hath borne tribulations in the love of God, the Lord of Names and Creator of the heavens. Say thou:

Praised be to Thee, O Thou Who hast revealed to me Thy lofty Horizon, aided me to recognize Thy most exalted Word, and drawn me nigh unto the station wherein the Ocean of Thy Oneness hath surged, shedding forth from its horizon the light of Thy unity. O my God! How can I render thanks to Thee for having blessed me with Thy generosity, assisted me to find the fragrance of Thy garment, and helped me to attain the cup which hath been proffered by the hand of Thy bestowal? I beseech Thee to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and help me to remember Thy verses in such wise that worldly affairs will not prevent me from turning my gaze towards Thee. Thou art verily the Forgiver of sins and the Most Merciful.

## BH08746: For some time now, the inhabitants of the heavens… {.unnumbered}

In the name of the Peerless Beloved!

For some time now, the inhabitants of the heavens and earth have been intoxicated, and the splendors of the Sun of trial and test have shone forth upon all things. O friends of God! Be ye detached from the mention of the world through His remembrance, and be free from the remembrance of all in the realms of creation through His memory. Be not grieved by the tribulations that have befallen you. Ere long will the sun of joy dawn from the horizon of divine victory, and the breezes of might shall pass, and the pavilion of glory shall be raised up, and the sign of God's triumph shall encompass all creation, and the point of tyranny shall be erased from the tablet of existence. This is a promise that shall not prove false. God willing, may you ever dwell beneath the shade of His loving-kindness and repose in the shadow of the Tree of His mercy. And the glory be upon you.

## BH09183: He it is Who shineth forth in splendour… {.unnumbered}

He it is Who shineth forth in splendour from the supreme horizon!

O My handmaiden! How many the men who, throughout the centuries and ages, expectantly awaited the promised Manifestation; yet, when His radiance dawned above the horizon of the world, all turned away from Him but for a few. Every handmaiden who attaineth unto the recognition of the King of Names, is accounted in the Book of God a true man, and so recorded by the Pen of the Most High. Yield thou thanks unto the Best-Beloved of the world, for having graciously assisted thee to recognize the Dayspring of His perspicuous signs, and the Dawning-Place of His undoubted proofs. Great is this bounty, and mighty this bestowal. Do thou preserve it in the Name of the one true God.

Verily doth the Wronged One make mention in this station of His other handmaiden, and giveth her the glad-tidings of the favors of God, the Self-Subsisting, the Most High. The glory be upon thee and upon those handmaidens who have believed in the Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

## BH09071: O Abu'l-Hasan! Engage in trade in such wise… {.unnumbered}

...O Abu'l-Hasan! Engage in trade in such wise that neither shall its profit gladden thee nor its loss grieve thee. Be content in all conditions with what has been ordained for thee from the Pen of God, the Guardian, the Self-Subsisting.... O Abu'l-Hasan! Consider commerce as the heaven whose sun is trustworthiness and whose moon is truthfulness. Commerce is a heaven whose sun is trustworthiness and whose moon is truthfulness. Trustworthiness is mentioned as the most glorious of all things before the Truth and is recorded in God's Book. Ask of the Truth that He may cause all to attain unto this most glorious, most exalted station. Verily He is the Powerful, the Mighty.

## BH09143: O ʿInayat! Upon thee and upon those with thee… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory in wisdom and utterance.

O ʿInayat! Upon thee and upon those with thee be the glory of God and His favors. Husayn, son of My Name, upon both of them be My glory, appeared before the Wronged One with thy letter. We heard thy call and with this blessed Tablet thy mention hath flowed from the Most Exalted Pen. We have heard that which thou didst commune with God through My tongue. Blessed art thou! We beseech God, exalted be He, to assist thee, honor thee, bestow upon thee, and give thee to drink from the Kawthar of life and whatsoever is befitting this blessed and wondrous Day. The glory from Us be upon thee and upon thy father and thine uncle and thy mother and the other leaves who have heard the call and turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon. Upon you and upon them be My prayers and My mercy which have preceded existence. There is no God but He, the Mighty, the Loving.

## BH09073: In My Name through which the ocean of bounty… {.unnumbered}

In My Name through which the ocean of bounty surged before the faces of all creation

O son of My Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. We bear witness that thou hast attained unto My Day, hast quaffed the choice wine of My utterance from the cup of My bounty, and hast heard My sweetest call and the shrilling of My most exalted Pen. Say:

Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name, through which Thou didst guide the nations unto the shore of the ocean of Thy Revelation, and gavest them to drink the Kawthar of reunion from the hands of Thy grace and bounty, to ordain for me, by Thy most glorious Pen, that which Thou hast ordained for the company of the pure in heart. Rain down then upon me, from the clouds of Thy favour, the showers of Thy mercy. Verily, Thou art powerful to do whatsoever Thou willest, and in Thy grasp are held the reins of the former and the latter generations. Praise be to Thee, O God of all worlds and Desire of the hearts of them that have attained unto true knowledge.

## BH09110: O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One!… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory, the Bestower of gifts and favors!

O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One! O Rida! Upon thee be the glory of God, the Lord of all beings. At the mere news of this propitious event, setting aside outward limitations and conventional bounds observed among men, she hath been named with the most excellent of names as a bounty from God, the Lord of the worlds. We beseech God to preserve her and protect her, and to manifest through her that which hath been manifested from among those men who have drawn nigh unto God. Verily, He is the Mighty, the Most Exalted. There can be no doubt, nor doth any uncertainty exist, that the one who is assisted and confirmed will manifest in every realm of her being that which will exalt her through His Name among His handmaidens and servants. Verily, He is powerful over all things.

## BH09115: O My fruit! Verily the Divine Lote-Tree desireth… {.unnumbered}

He is the Everlasting, the Eternal, Who speaketh before all faces.

O My fruit! Verily the Divine Lote-Tree desireth to raise thee up through its sovereignty, and draw thee nigh through its bounty and its hosts, and cause thee to hear its sweetest call and the shrill voice of its Most Exalted Pen. Grieve thou not over anything, for verily He is with thee and will help thee through His grace, and He is the Mighty, the Bestower. Say:

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Praise be unto Thee for having guided me unto Thy straight path and made known unto me Thy Great Announcement and given me to drink, from the hand of Thy bounty, the choice wine of Thy utterance. I beseech Thee, by the breezes of Thy Revelation and the mysteries of Thy Cause, to open before my face, through the key of Thy Most Great Name, the doors of grace and bounty. Verily Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful. The Glory rest upon thee and upon those who love thee in the path of God, the Almighty, the Unconstrained.

## BH09144: He speaketh as He willeth {.unnumbered}

He speaketh as He willeth.

O My Most Great Branch! Thy letter hath been presented unto this Wronged One, and We have heard that which thou didst commune with God, the Lord of the worlds.

We have made Thee a shelter for all mankind, a shield unto all who are in heaven and on earth, a stronghold for whosoever hath believed in God, the Incomparable, the All-Knowing. God grant that through Thee He may protect them, may enrich and sustain them, that He may inspire Thee with that which shall be a wellspring of wealth unto all created things, an ocean of bounty unto all men, and the dayspring of mercy unto all peoples.

He, verily, is the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

We beseech Him to water through thee the earth and all that is therein, that there may grow from it the herbs of wisdom and utterance and the hyacinths of knowledge and understanding. He, verily, is the Protector of whosoever turneth unto Him and the Helper of whosoever calleth upon Him. There is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Praised One.

## BH09105: O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One!… {.unnumbered}

In the name of the one incomparable, almighty God.

O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One! Great is this day and the manifestation of favor from the horizon of the heaven of supreme grace is most glorious. We have desired at this time to adorn thee with a light that neither alteration shall overtake nor setting follow. Say:

Glory be unto Thee, O Lord of all beings and God of all who dwell in the kingdom of names! I beseech Thee by the effulgences of the Daystar of Thy Will whereby the heaven of Thy knowledge and the earth of Thy purpose were illumined, to open before my face, through the key of Thy Most Great Name, the door of bounty and bestowal. Then make me steadfast in Thy Cause and Thy love. Verily Thou art the All-Powerful, the Most Exalted, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful. By My life and by God's Cause! The treasures of the world and whatsoever is with the kings and rulers cannot equal this Tablet.

## BH08841: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! This… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! This is Thy servant whom Thou hast related unto Thyself and made him one of the twigs of the Tree of Thy singleness and one of the leaves of the Lote-Tree of Thy oneness. O Lord! Since Thou hast honored him with this supreme gift and this greatest bounty, enable him to do that which Thou lovest and pleasest, and assist him with Thy confirmations, O Thou in Whose hand is the kingdom of earth and heaven. Kindle within his heart the fire of Thy love in such wise that through its flame the world may be set ablaze, that he may forget all else save Thee, and find intimate communion with Thy remembrance and love. For this befitteth him in the presence of the radiance of the lights of Thy countenance, and is worthy of his relationship to Thee, O Thou Who art the Beloved of the worlds. Moreover, assign him an excellent seat with Thee, and aid him in his affairs, O Thou in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things. Thou, verily, art the Almighty, the Most Powerful.

## BH08808: My remembrance unto My leaf who hath turned unto… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the All-Knowing!

My remembrance unto My leaf who hath turned unto the horizon from which hath shone forth the Day-Star of My Name, the Lord of all names. She did drink the Kawthar of utterance from the hands of her Lord, the Most Merciful, at a time when men were wrapped in heedlessness and dissension. She took hold of the Book of God with a strength from Him and testified to that which God Himself had testified in the return: that there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Most Exalted. We make mention of thee and of those handmaidens who have believed in God, the One, the Chosen, and We glorify thee and them and those whom neither the doubts of the people of the Bayan nor the clamor of every froward denier have kept back. O My leaf! We counsel thee and My handmaidens to manifest the Most Great Steadfastness and that whereby the Cause of God, the Lord of creation, may be exalted. The Glory be upon thee and upon those who have not broken the Covenant.

## BH08926: Your name hath been mentioned before the Throne… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Holy, the Most Exalted

Your name hath been mentioned before the Throne, and there hath been sent down for thee that which rejoiceth the hearts of them that are endowed with understanding. He is verily the Sword of God amongst His servants and His mercy unto the righteous. Hold thou fast unto the Sure Handle which We have manifested in the temple of man. Blessed be the All-Merciful Who hath sent Him with the truth with sovereignty and power. Is there any doubt concerning Him? Nay, by His own Self, the Truth! Is there any uncertainty about Him? Nay, by His own Self, the All-Bountiful! He hath appeared in such wise that none can deny Him save him who hath denied God and His proof throughout all eternity.

Thus hath the Dove of Paradise warbled upon the branches of the Divine Lote-Tree, from thy Lord, the Almighty, the Compeller. Render thanks unto thy Lord in all conditions and say: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who hast remembered me whilst I was in the clutches of the wicked ones.

## BH08975: The Book of the All-Merciful hath been sent down… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Exalted, the Most High

The Book of the All-Merciful hath been sent down in truth from God, the Lord of all worlds. It commandeth the people to justice and to that which God hath revealed in His perspicuous Book. Say: O people, fear ye God! Take hold of that which ye have been bidden by One Who is All-Knowing, All-Wise. O My Afnan! Lo, We call them unto God while they call Us to their desires. Know of a certainty they are among the most lost. Say: He heareth not your call, nor walketh in your ways. Verily His is a straight path whereunto He guideth all. He, verily, is powerful over all things. Blessed art thou and blessed is he who hath arisen to serve the Cause, and blessed is he who hath loved you for the sake of God, the Lord of all worlds. The Glory be upon thee from One Who is the All-Powerful, the All-Mighty.

## BH09025: Be not disquieted by separation. By God! Through your… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Sufficing.

Be not disquieted by separation. By God! Through your parting the pillars of the Word have been rent asunder, the columns of majesty have trembled, and the life of the inmates of Paradise hath been altered—as though the letter Kaf had been cleft apart and torn away from its beloved Nun.

Be patient, O handmaid of God; then again, be patient. Put thy trust in God, the All-Subduing, the Self-Subsistent. How many of My handmaidens have We tried, even as We have tried this one, and Our mercy took them suddenly while they were unaware.

Grieve not, then, for the afflictions that have touched thee. Ere long will God transmute thy sorrow into the Greatest Joy, and will send down that which shall unburden thy heart, whilst those who are far off shall be filled with consternation.

Call thou upon God, thy Lord, in the darkness of night and the brightness of day, that He may cause to descend upon thee, from the clouds of His bounty, that whereby thy heart shall find repose, and the hearts of those who are assured of the signs of their Lord.

## BH11665: Praise be to the Court of the Intended One… {.unnumbered}

Praise be to the Court of the Intended One, Whom neither the opposition and objection of the world nor the indifference and denial of nations could deter from His all-conquering, all-subduing purpose....

...the ignorant one of the land of Kaf and Ra inflicted upon the Exalted One—may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him—that which the pen is ashamed to mention. Each year a book of refutation emerged from the treasury of his heedlessness. Likewise did the author of Nasikhu't-Tawarikh write concerning that Exalted Being that which no idolater has ever uttered. Some have become confused about certain matters, while others are aflame with the fire of jealousy and hatred, saying that which they do not comprehend. God shall soon erase their traces, their names and their mentions, and shall establish what He desires. Verily, He is the Powerful, the Unconstrained....

## BH08646: Praise be to God, and peace and blessings be… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be He in wisdom and utterance

Praise be to God, and peace and blessings be upon His Prophets who carried out what they were commanded by Him. He is verily the All-Commanding, the All-Wise. And furthermore, regarding the matter of not wearing the veil that you mentioned—the claimant brought a letter to prove his claim, and since the letter was from another person it was burned. This action is not pleasing, for you must follow the example of God, exalted be His glory. Today, moral character is among the hosts of God. It is hoped that through this you will render assistance to God's Cause. We beseech God in all circumstances to aid you and enable you to do what He loves and is pleased with. Verily He is the Protector of the sincere ones and does not allow the reward of the doers of good to be lost. It would have been more pleasing in the sight of God if you had informed him in a loving manner.

## BH08743: O thou who journeyest unto God and emigratest toward… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious

O thou who journeyest unto God and emigratest toward Him! Praise be to the Eternal Beloved that thou hast reached the shore of the Most Great Sea and arrived at the abode of immortality, and art numbered among those souls who, at the end of their journeys, discovered the True Ka'bah and ultimate Goal. How many souls rushed forth into the deadly wilderness and were consumed by the heat of deprivation, never tasting a drop of the wine of reunion from the hand of the Cup-bearer of attainment, while you, through the favor of the Most Glorious Beloved, have entered beneath the sheltering shade of the Tree of the Uttermost End. This is a bounty that hath ever been the ultimate desire of the denizens of the Supreme Concourse. Therefore, speak forth in praise of thy Ancient Lord for what He hath bestowed upon thee through His grace and favor, for indeed His favor toward thee is great.

## BH08757: Free from the least trace of doubt or uncertainty… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His glory.

Free from the least trace of doubt or uncertainty, man hath been brought into being for fellowship and for meeting; the very advent of man beareth witness thereto, and the power of seeking hath been implanted in all things. This is of man’s very nature. Thus is it clear and manifest that this Wronged One seeketh that which your honor seeketh likewise. Yet the light of fairness lieth veiled behind the clouds, and the day-star of justice remaineth hidden behind its coverings; wherefore the vain imaginings of men have become a barrier and an obstacle.

In such a case I crave pardon of your honor. My hope is this: that the affection which hath in these days become manifest may not be effaced or taken away, and that this friendship may remain eternal and enduring in the book of the world. Fidelity is beloved. Blessed is he whom God adorneth therewith.

## BH08762: These are the verses of Command, sent down… {.unnumbered}

These are the verses of Command, sent down in truth; and verily, they are the most exalted. Ere long will God, through them, bring into being a people whom none shall recognize, and whom the eyes of those who have turned away from the Ancient Countenance shall be powerless to behold; for upon their faces shall appear the radiance of holiness from this Most Ancient Outlook.

And as for thee, O handmaid of God, safeguard thyself in those days when the dust of hypocrisy hath encompassed all the horizons. Then hold fast unto this cord, whereunto the temples of glory have clung while seated upon shining seats of sanctity.

And when sorrow toucheth thee, rejoice in My sovereignty, the All-Subduing, the All-Powerful. Beware lest thou grieve for aught. Put thy trust, in all thine affairs, in My true Self; this is better for thee than all things, and than whatsoever hath been decreed between earth and heaven.

## BH08769: We send greetings to Jinab-i-Nazir. We beseech God… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise

We send greetings to Jinab-i-Nazir. We beseech God to unite what has been separated from him and to grant him good in the hereafter and in this world. We wrote two letters regarding his people, but both before and after, Jinab-i-Amin and Mirza Mihdi gave news of disappointment, and according to Mirza Mihdi's letter they have turned towards Yazd. That same letter was sent, but Jinab-i-Nazir should not be grieved. Firstly, because no relationship is worthy of mention in relation to the Truth, and secondly, they can still return from Yazd. We beseech the True One to manifest that which is the cause of the greatest joy. Verily He is the Powerful, verily He is the Commander, the All-Wise. The Glory be upon you and upon those with you.

## BH08775: Hamid, in one station, is a name of God… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the All-Praised.

Hamid, in one station, is a name of God, and in another station, a name pertaining unto the creature. Should the true Sovereign make this Hamid the manifestation of His own name, the All-Praised, an entire world would adorn itself beneath the shadow of the Tree of mercy. Yet, by reason of the pride of sovereignty and dominion, this is passing difficult. The matter lieth in the hand of God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

O my God, my God! Since Thy Book hath given glad tidings of this Revelation, make known unto Thy servants that for which they were created. O Lord! Thou art the Generous, and Thou art the Mighty, the Omnipotent. O Lord! Deprive not Thy creatures of this Most Great Ocean. I beseech Thee, O Lord of the world, by the Most Great Name, to aid him whom Thou hast honored by Thy Tablet and for whom Thou hast sent down Thy Word. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things.

## BH08821: Glory be to Thee, O my God, the God… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him Who overshadoweth all names!

Glory be to Thee, O my God, the God of all created things and the Educator of all contingent beings! I beseech Thee by Thy Cause which hath encompassed all things in existence, and by the Call which hath been raised by Thy command, O Lord of names and attributes, to assist Thy handmaiden who hath turned toward the horizon of Thy Revelation to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee amongst Thy handmaidens. Then open before her face the gate of Thy bounty. Verily, Thou art the Almighty over whatsoever Thou willest and the Speaker amongst all created things. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous, the All-Merciful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Glory and praise and remembrance and honor be upon Thee, O my leaf, and upon those handmaidens who turned to God when the Cause was manifested and the Call was raised, and who attained unto that which the radiant leaf attained, she who aided the Cause of God before the face of the Lord upon the snow-white spot.

## BH08832: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee… {.unnumbered}

In the name of God, the Most Wondrous, the Most Inaccessible

Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name, which was made to suffer at the hands of the idolaters among Thy creatures and was encompassed by sorrows from every direction in such wise as cannot be described in words, to enable me to remember Thee and praise Thee in these days wherein all have turned away from Thy beauty and opposed Thee and shown pride before the Manifestation of Thy Cause. O my Lord! I see no helper other than Thee, and no supporter besides Thee. I beseech Thee to make me steadfast in Thy love and remembrance, and this is what lies within my power. Verily Thou knowest what is within my soul, and Thou art the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. O my Lord! Deprive me not of the splendors of the light of Thy countenance, whereby the horizons have been illumined. There is no God but Thee, the Almighty, the Glorious, the All-Forgiving.

## BH08856: Glorified art Thou, O my God and my Lord… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed!

Glorified art Thou, O my God and my Lord and my Support and my Beloved and my Heart's Desire and the Object of the desire of them that are nigh unto Thee! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name, and by Thy irrevocable Command, and Thy straight Path, and Thy perspicuous Book, and by the lights of Thy countenance and the breezes of Thy Revelation and the mysteries of Thy knowledge, that Thou ordain for Thy servant every good and every bounty and every mercy which Thou hast sent down in the tablets of Thy glory for them that are nigh unto Thy creation. Verily Thou art the Almighty, the All-Wise. O Lord! Open before my face the doors of Thy grace and bounty. I testify that in Thy grasp is the key to every mighty door. There is no God but Thee, the All-Knowing, and Thou art the All-Wise, and Thou art the All-Commanding, the All-Informed.

May the glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of God's Kingdom be upon thee and upon every truthful, faithful one.

## BH08860: Glory be unto Thee, O Lord of all being… {.unnumbered}

He is the Comforter, the Consoler, the Forgiving, the Compassionate.

Glory be unto Thee, O Lord of all being and Ruler of the seen and the unseen! I implore Thee by the tongue from which the springs of wisdom have gushed forth in the world of creation, and by the heart which Thou hast made the repository of Thy knowledge and Thy mysteries, and the treasury of Thy wisdom and Thy verses, to send down, at all times, upon him who hath ascended unto Thee the rain of Thy mercy and the showers of Thy providence. Thou art the One to Whose bounty every tongue hath testified, and to Whose grace every eloquent speaker hath born witness. Thou doest as Thou pleasest and ordainest what Thou desirest. Thou, verily, art the Almighty, the All-Praised.

Furthermore, We entreat Thee, O God of the world, to destine for those who are related to him that which shall draw them nigh unto Thee under all conditions. Thou, verily, art the All-Sufficing, the Most Exalted. No God is there save Thee, the All-Glorious, the Most Bountiful.

## BH08863: All praise be unto the Almighty, the Sanctified-glorified be… {.unnumbered}

He is God, blessed and exalted is He

All praise be unto the Almighty, the Sanctified-glorified be His power-Who hath ordained that the tyranny of the unjust and the violence of the oppressors should become the means whereby the true lovers draw nigh unto the glorious habitation of the Best-Beloved and the sincere among His servants attain the Paradise of communion with Him Who is the Desire of all men, and that sufferings and tribulations should serve as the instrument whereby His Word of command is spread abroad and the standards of His praise are unfurled in all regions.

How great is His transcendent power, how immensely exalted His all-embracing Will, inasmuch as He produceth light from fire and joy from sorrow.

They that are sunk in heedlessness fondly imagine that massacre and crucifixion cause the fire of the Word of God to be extinguished, and regard martyrdom as a devastating injury. They are utterly oblivious of the truth that through such afflictions the Cause of God is exalted, its fame is blazoned far and wide, and the martyrs themselves are enabled to attain the boundless retreats of nearness unto God. Immeasurably exalted is the Lord of Wisdom Who doeth that which He willeth and ordaineth whatsoever He pleaseth.

## BH08893: The world hath been transformed: the mountain walketh upon… {.unnumbered}

The world hath been transformed: the mountain walketh upon its way, the sun uttereth speech, and the trembling of the Manifestation hath stirred the Sinai of revelation to motion. Glorified be God! It is as though the Resurrection were established and the Hour laid bare before men’s eyes. The misleader hath become a guide!

Say: what hast thou to do with such vain imaginings and grievous errors? God have mercy upon one who knew his own measure and station. At the time when the names were bestowed upon the world, thou wast not. Fear thou God, the Almighty, the All-Powerful. Speak according to thine own degree. And if We will, We take from the dust and manifest from it names after names until the names and their kingdoms end. Indeed when you are thunderstruck by this compelling Word, it matters not, for according to the blessed word revealed from the Dawning-Place of the Primal Point—upon Him be the glory of God, the Lord of all beings—even those who stood at Sinai are thunderstruck, let alone those below them, as is clear and evident.

## BH09070: Glorified art Thou, O God of Names and Creator… {.unnumbered}

He is the Compassionate, the Generous

Glorified art Thou, O God of Names and Creator of earth and heaven! I beseech Thee by Thy most great signs and by them who circle round Thy throne, O Lord of all being and Master of the seen and unseen, to assist Thy handmaiden and leaf that her mention may endure in Thy kingdom. Thou art the One Who, O my God, hast related Thy chosen ones to Thy Tree. Ordain for them, both men and women, that which will draw them nigh unto Thee in all conditions. Verily, Thou art the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. There is none other God but Thee, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

Send down Thy blessings, O my God, upon those who have attained the blessing of recognizing Thee in Thy days, who have turned unto Thee and have drunk the choice sealed wine of revelation from the hands of Thy bounty. O Lord! Illumine their hearts with the lights of Thy knowledge and their faces with the radiance of Thy countenance. Then ordain for them through Thy Most Exalted Pen the good of the hereafter and of this world. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful.

## BH09174: O Yehuda! Praise thou the Object of the adoration… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

O Yehuda! Praise thou the Object of the adoration of the world Who hath aided thee to recognize the Dawning-Place of His Revelation and the Dayspring of His inspiration. While like unto the pole of the divines of Iran, namely Shaykh Muhammad Hasan, he slipped from the path and returned to his former station. Glory be to God! Every day the blessed words "He maketh your highest to be the lowest among you, and your lowest to be the highest" are witnessed and made manifest.

Praise be to God that thou hast attained and been adorned with the recognition of God, exalted be His glory. Now one matter remaineth, and that is steadfastness in the love of God. Many are the atheists, numberless are the barking ones, traitors exist, and thieves are manifest. We beseech God to preserve thee and His loved ones from the evil of these people. They have denied the signs of God, and His sovereignty, and His greatness, and His power, and they were among the most lost in the Book of God, the Lord of all worlds.

## BH11666: All praise, glorification, mention and utterance befitteth the Object… {.unnumbered}

All praise, glorification, mention and utterance befitteth the Object of all creation, Who hath graciously aided His handmaidens and guided them until they attained unto the Straight Path and the Great Announcement. How many among the great ones and the learned are today heedless of the Self-Subsisting and deprived of the Choice Wine that is sealed. This is the meaning of the former word which declareth:

> "He maketh the highest to be lowest, and the lowest to be highest."

His loving-kindness hath encompassed all, His mercy hath preceded all things, and He hath created countless means whereby He might lead that honored handmaiden, through the attraction of His call, to the Most Exalted Horizon. He is the One Who hath power to draw the faithful to the heaven of nearness and to consign the wayward to the nethermost fire. His is the power, the strength, the majesty and the glory. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. He is the Self-Sufficient, the Most High....

## BH11667: O My loved ones in Faran! The All-Merciful remembereth… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him through Whom surged the ocean of utterance!

O My loved ones in Faran! The All-Merciful remembereth you in these days wherein the Sun of inner meanings hath dawned from the horizon of utterance by the command of God, the Lord of Religions. Break ye the idols of idle fancies by the arm of certitude, then make mention of your Lord with joy and fragrance. Be thou speaking in My remembrance, enkindled with the fire of My love, turning unto My countenance, and facing toward Mine horizon which God hath made the Dayspring of lights.

Say: This is the Day of remembrance and utterance, did ye but know it, and this is the Day of proof and evidence, could ye but understand it. Arise to aid the Cause and be not of them that perceive not.
