The glory shining from My horizon be upon thee and upon thy brother who was mentioned before the Throne, and upon those who have attained unto this irrevocable Cause.

## BH11668: O Ali-Muhammad! Mention of thee hath been made before… {.unnumbered}

He is the Witness from His Most Exalted Horizon!

O Ali-Muhammad! Mention of thee hath been made before the Wronged One. If thou wert to discover the fruit of this utterance, thou wouldst, for as long as thou livest, utter "Thine is the praise, O God of all the worlds!" Know thou the value of the mention of God, and through His Name adorn thyself with the ornament of spiritual virtues. Goodly character is, each and every one, a helper of the Truth.

In diverse Tablets We have enjoined upon the servants amity, trustworthiness, faithfulness, love, compassion, and unity. Blessed is he who hath with the ear of reality hearkened unto the divine counsels and acted in accordance therewith.

Be thou thankful unto the Desired One of the world and say: Unto Thee be praise, unto Thee be thanks, unto Thee be glory, unto Thee be fidelity, unto Thee be splendor, unto Thee be light, O Thou the Desired One of the worlds and the Beloved of them that have recognized Thee!

## BH11898: O Ibrahim! We have desired to make mention… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

O Ibrahim! We have desired to make mention of thee and to remind thee for the sake of God, the Lord of the worlds, and to counsel thee regarding trustworthiness and chastity and whatsoever God hath revealed in His perspicuous Book.

Say: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued the hearts of Thy servants and illumined their hearts with the light of Thy knowledge, to enable me to visit Thy Sacred House and to act in such wise as would cause my remembrance to endure amongst all remembrances. Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Supreme, the Unconstrained.

We make mention of two handmaidens and counsel them to remember and praise God and to act according to that which they have been bidden by God, the Lord of all beings. We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to ordain for them that which He hath ordained for His devoted handmaidens. He, verily, is the Revealer of verses and the Lord of names and attributes.

## BH11845: Hearken, O handmaiden who art extinguished in the glory… {.unnumbered}

Hearken, O handmaiden who art extinguished in the glory of the deep and surging sea of fidelity, if thou art of the devoted ones! Turn not to anyone except God if thou art of those who draw nigh. Gaze upon the countenance of Beauty if thou art of those who witness, and testify in thy heart that verily He is the True One, there is no God but Him, and be not of the corrupt ones.

As mentioned, some corruption hath appeared from you, and this is unworthy of your station. Most assuredly make amends for this corruption, for today the True One will not be well pleased with you save through redressing what hath gone before. God is witness that grievous injury hath in truth befallen you.

## BH09586: This is a Book unto her who hath believed… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the Beauteous!

This is a Book unto her who hath believed in God and was numbered among the devoted ones in the Mother Book. O handmaiden of God! Be thou patient in whatsoever befalleth thee, and be not distressed by anything. Put thy trust in God, thy Lord and the Lord of all the worlds together. Grieve not over this world and whatsoever occurreth therein, and hold fast unto the sanctified and blessed handle. Thus doth the Tongue of God make mention of thee, that thou mayest detach thyself from all things and turn unto the direction of God, a station of praised nearness. Thus doth God single out whom He willeth with His mercy, that the grace may be from Him precedent unto the worlds. And the Spirit be upon thee and upon those women who remember God, their Lord, in every eventide and dawn.

## BH09682: In My Name, the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful {.unnumbered}

In My Name, the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful

O Ali! Thou hast been mentioned before the Throne and hast attained the grace of God, the Lord of all worlds. Thou hast been under the glance of divine favor, and unto thee hath been directed the gaze of God from this glorious station. Be thou steadfast in My Cause. By the life of God! We shall soon make manifest the recompense of deeds in such wise that every tongue shall exclaim: "Blessed be God, the Recompenser, the Bestower, the Compassionate, the All-Wise!" We counsel thee to preserve this station and whatsoever shall elevate thy rank in this mighty Cause. Convey My greetings unto thy father and thy brother and unto those with him. Soon shall a Tablet be revealed for him which shall testify that there is none other God but Me, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

## BH09640: O thou who drinkest the choice wine of My… {.unnumbered}

O thou who drinkest the choice wine of My utterance, who art mentioned by My Pen, and who soarest in My atmosphere! The Greater Branch hath appeared before My countenance and made mention of thee and of My loved ones whom thou didst mention in thy letter. We have mentioned each one of them with that which hath diffused the fragrance of grace and bounty. We beseech God to attract them through His verses, to draw them nigh unto the court of His glory, and to sanctify them from that which beseemeth not His loved ones. Verily, He is powerful over all things. Blessed art thou, inasmuch as God hath made thee the cause of the deliverance of His servants and the savior of His creation from the well of idle fancies and vain imaginings. He, verily, is the Confirmer, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

## BH09190: We beseech from the Ocean of Bounty, the Lord… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of the One Incomparable Friend!

We beseech from the Ocean of Bounty, the Lord of existence and the Sovereign of the seen and unseen, that He may, at all times, bestow upon His chosen ones and His sincere servants a portion of the sealed wine which hath been unsealed through His blessed Name, the Self-Subsisting. Verily, He is the All-Bountiful, the Generous, the Single, the One, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

O thou who hearkeneth unto My call and cleaveth fast unto My Cord! This Day is the Day of assistance and the Day of attraction. Ye must hold fast unto wisdom and utterance in capturing hearts and souls. This is the decisive Command which hath descended from the direction of the Most Great Name. Blessed are they that act, and blessed are they that are firmly established.

The Glory be upon thee and upon those who have believed in God, the Single, the All-Informed.

## BH09683: O ʿAndalib! Forget not My remembrance of thee, nor… {.unnumbered}

He is the Compassionate, the Generous.

O ʿAndalib! Forget not My remembrance of thee, nor My care for thee, nor My grace unto thee, nor My compassion toward thee. Cast away that which would abase thee, and take fast hold of that which shall exalt thee. Every day He is engaged in a matter: He abaseth some and uplifteth others. The eye of My mercy weepeth for thee; by the life of God, My sorrow on thy behalf is great.

We beseech Him, exalted be He, to aid thee and to bestow upon thee that which beseemeth thee in these days of thy Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Cling thou unto the cord of grace and forgiveness, holding fast to the hem of His Name, the Generous. Call thou thyself to account before Me. Verily, the Wronged One desireth to behold thee sanctified from all that ill befitteth thee, and standing firm and steadfast in this mighty Cause.

## BH09606: O Ism-i-Jud! The letter of the Afnan, upon him… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His station in mention and utterance.

O Ism-i-Jud! The letter of the Afnan, upon him be the peace of God and His loving-kindness, was received and is accounted in the presence of the Wronged One among exalted words, for from the Lote-Tree of his mention is kindled the fire of love and from his praise wafts the fragrance of the love of the All-Merciful. Blessed is he and blessed are they who have attained. We beseech God to draw the servants through him to His most exalted horizon and supreme height. Verily He is the All-Bountiful, the Generous. He has ever been and continues to be remembered in the presence of the Wronged One. Peace and glory be upon him and upon those with him and upon those who love him and hearken to his words.

## BH09219: Today each hour of the day proclaims at… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Ancient, the Most Great, the Most Glorious!

Today each hour of the day proclaims at the highest pitch: "By the life of God, the Hour has come, yet the people perceive it not!" And every minute cries out saying: "The Day of God has arrived, yet the people understand it not!" The heedlessness of the people has reached such a state that they have turned away from One Who has sent down from the heaven of the Divine Will verses sublime and wondrous, equivalent to all previous Books, and they occupy themselves with their own vain imaginings. We beseech God, exalted be His glory, to confirm thee with such steadfastness that the tempests of doubts and the storms of idle fancies may not move thee. Verily, He is powerful over all things.

## BH09612: O Ismi Mihdi! The servant in attendance read… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

O Ismi Mihdi! The servant in attendance read the letter from Afnan A. and H., upon him be My glory, which he sent to you. God willing, may they ever be nourished by the fruits of the Tree of divine knowledge, gaze toward the horizon of the All-Merciful, and arise to serve the Cause.

This matter is one that has had and has no likeness or parallel. Its effects remain concealed due to the world's lack of capacity, but the Mighty, the Trustworthy shall make them manifest.

We send Our greetings upon him and upon the Afnans there and upon those whose names were mentioned in his letter. Praise be to God, they have attained to the recognition of Truth, of which most of the world remains deprived, and act according to His command. By My life, this is a mighty station with thy Lord, the Exalted, the Great.

## BH09637: In My Name, the Commander, the All-Wise, before… {.unnumbered}

In My Name, the Commander, the All-Wise, before the faces of all who are in heaven and on earth!

O My loved ones in Shiraz! The Supreme Pen hath testified and doth testify at all times that He is the Single One, the One, the Powerful, the Strong, the Triumphant, the Mighty. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He desireth, and He is the All-Bountiful, the Generous.

We have bestowed the custodianship of the Holy House upon the Most Exalted Leaf, consort of the Primal Point, and upon her sister—upon both of them be the glory of God, His mercy and His loving-kindness. This custodianship hath been granted to that House by God. Thus have We adorned it with the ornament of grace and confirmed the decree with My seal, the Mighty, the Beloved. This honor and bounty hath been specifically granted to the sister and her descendants, from God, the Bestower, the All-Bountiful, the Ever-Flowing, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

## BH09371: Glorified is He Who hath created all things… {.unnumbered}

In the name of Him Who is the Guardian over all names!

Glorified is He Who hath created all things for the recognition of the Dawning-Place of His Cause and the Dayspring of His grace and the Source of His commandments and ordinances, Who hath sent down His proof and made manifest His path and guided the people unto that which profiteth them. He, verily, is the Almighty, the Exalted, the All-Bountiful.

O Kamal! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of the beginning and the end. Say: My God, my God! Thou seest Thy servant who hath turned unto Thee, and hath acknowledged the sanctity of Thy Being from all likeness and the immunity of Thy Essence from all similitude. I beseech Thee by Him through the light of Whose countenance the heavens were illumined and through the fragrance of Whose raiment Yathrib and Batha were perfumed, to ordain for me all the good Thou hast ordained in Thy Book for Thy loved ones. Thou, verily, art the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

## BH09597: This is a Day wherein the Spirit calleth out… {.unnumbered}

He is the Hearer, the Answerer, and He is the Witness, the All-Informed.

This is a Day wherein the Spirit calleth out in this wilderness, saying: "Here am I, here am I, O Beloved of the worlds! Here am I, here am I, O Thou Who art the Object of worship of all who are in the heavens and on earth!" When thou hast received My Tablet, turn thy face toward God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting. Say: "Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name, and glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy binding Command whereby Thou hast subdued the hearts of the nations, to send down upon me from the heaven of Thy bounty that which beseemeth Thy generosity, O Lord of eternity. Then make me so steadfast in Thy service that nothing shall deter me and no affair shall weaken me. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful, the All-Bountiful."

## BH11669: O son of Abhar! Upon thee be My glory… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him Who is the Supreme Ruler over what was and what shall be!

O son of Abhar! Upon thee be My glory, My loving-kindness, My mercy and My grace which have encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth.

Bear thou witness unto that which My Most Exalted Pen hath testified: that there is none other God but Me, the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful. I have appeared and made manifest that which was recorded in the Books of God and treasured up in His knowledge; yet most of the people are as dead.

We bear witness that thou wast present and didst see, hear, and make mention of My servants, both men and women, and We have revealed for each and every one that which cannot be equaled by the treasuries of kings. He in Whose possession is a perspicuous Book doth testify to this.

The Glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of My mercy be upon thee and upon those who have held fast unto the cord of God, the Almighty, the All-Glorious.

## BH09593: In the Name of Him through Whom was opened… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him through Whom was opened the gate of bounty to all who are in earth and heaven! This is a Book that speaketh the truth and summoneth all peoples unto God, the Lord of the worlds. This is a Tablet which God hath made the bearer of His verses and the Dawning-Place of His grace, the Mighty, the Wondrous.

Say: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the Mount of Thy knowledge, and by Him Who conversed upon it, and by the Tree of Thy utterance and that which Thou didst reveal unto it through Thy power and sovereignty, to ordain for me all the good Thou hast sent down in Thy Book. O Lord! Deny me not from standing before the gate of Thy grandeur, and make me not bereft of the outpourings of Thy days. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the Protector of all in the heavens and on earth.

## BH09325: His honor Husayn, upon him be My glory… {.unnumbered}

He is the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful.

His honor Husayn, upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, submitted your letter to the Most Holy Court, and it was illumined by the light of the presence and glance of the Lord of all beings. Say:

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Him Who conversed upon Sinai, Who has ascended the throne of manifestation, and by the fire of Thy Sacred Tree, and by Thy Greatest Name whereby Thou hast subdued the cities of names, to open before my face the door of Thy bounty, Thy grace, Thy might and Thy wealth. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. The doubts of the doubtful cannot hinder Thee, nor the cawing of the crows, nor can the oppressors' might frighten Thee. Verily Thou art the All-Powerful, the Supreme, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

## BH09566: A Tablet has been revealed and sent down… {.unnumbered}

A Tablet has been revealed and sent down from the heaven of the Divine Will specifically for His Honor the Deputy Governor—deliver it to him. Likewise, the petitions that were sent have attained the Most Holy Court and all have been favored with replies, however the reply to each one has been inscribed at the top of the petitions themselves. In truth, all the petitions have been crowned with the utterances of the Beloved of the worlds. Blessed are they who have attained to the grace of God, the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful. Similarly, a Tablet has been revealed from the heaven of favor specifically for Jinab-i-Gudraz, and mention has also been made therein of Jinab-i-Rashid the Martyr. In truth, the utmost favor concerning them both has been manifested in that Tablet. Blessed be they both.

## BH09189: From the beginning of creation We willed, and lo!… {.unnumbered}

From the beginning of creation We willed, and lo! the ocean of bounty came into being. The divine wind arose, fraught with an inward heat. The sea was stirred to motion; from that motion grace was made manifest, and from that grace fire appeared. Two became four, and from that four the world was unveiled. This is but one stage of creation in one world among the worlds.

## BH09194: The causes of rancor and hatred have appeared… {.unnumbered}

The causes of rancor and hatred have appeared on every side. Some have purposed to efface the Book of the Bayan revealed by the Bab; and now all are occupied therewith. Their aim is this: to blot out the grace of this Most Great Baha'i Revelation. Yet the Book of the Bayan itself proclaimeth that which the Qur'an had ordained. God is witness and the Truth testifieth that this Wronged One, in bearing afflictions and trials beyond all reckoning, hath had no purpose save the comfort of humankind, their freedom, and the extinguishing of the fire of malevolence.

And further, the mention of this Wronged One is set forth therein in such wise that no man hath had, nor hath now, any room for denial or objection. The request of this servant is that, if the Bayan be found in those pages, they should take it up and preserve it.

## BH09199: Praise be unto God Who hath adorned man… {.unnumbered}

Praise be unto God Who hath adorned man with the ornament of utterance, and hath taught him the mystery of what hath been and of all that is within the realm of being, through His saying: "He created man; He taught him speech."

By "man," in that which the All-Merciful hath sent down in the Furqan, is intended the Mystery of His self-subsisting Being, the object of the adoration of His oneness, the all-embracing Word of light, the spirit of the Kingdom, and the primal, everlasting radiance. He is the gulf whereby God hath quickened the earth after its death, and the light whereby earth and heaven have been illumined.

He is the first adornment and the first remembrance. Through Him hath the Trumpet been blown, the decree of resurrection been made manifest, the Herald cried aloud, and all have been gladdened by the advent of the Lord of creation.

## BH09203: The nightingale maketh remembrance, the dove extolleth its Creator… {.unnumbered}

The nightingale maketh remembrance, the dove extolleth its Creator, the cock proclaimeth, and the warbling bird celebrateth its Originator; yet the True One—glorified be His majesty—hath established by proof that He is sanctified above whatsoever is remembered, extolled, described, or praised, and remaineth even as He was from everlasting eternity.

Verily, He is He Who is mentioned in the Books, alluded to in the Scriptures, recorded in the scrolls, and hidden within the treasuries of the Tablets. My Most Exalted Pen beareth witness that thou didst hasten unto Him and didst attain His presence, as thou didst stand at the door.

The very essence of joy hath been stirred by My Most Exalted Word, and the ocean of gladness hath surged by virtue of that light wherewith the horizons have been illumined.

## BH09204: O my God! This is Thy servant who hath… {.unnumbered}

He is the Single, the One, the Eternal!

O my God! This is Thy servant who hath striven with his spirit, his heart, his inner being and his body, until he reached the shore of Thy Most Great Ocean and drank from the pure, flowing waters of reunion at the dawning of the brilliant rays from the Sun of Thy oneness. Therefore, O my God, I beseech Thee by Thy manifest signs in the temples of unity and Thy resplendent traces in the manifestations of oneness, to ordain for him every good thing Thou hast ordained in the kingdom of Thy creation for Thy sincere servants, and to send down upon him the outpourings from the cloud of Thy greatest mercy's heaven. O Thou in Whose hand are the keys of all hearts! For we are all poor at Thy gate and abased before the appearance of Thy might and sovereignty. We possess nothing in Thy kingdom.

## BH09267: God willing, through the merciful favor of the All-Merciful… {.unnumbered}

God willing, through the merciful favor of the All-Merciful, may ye abide glad and joyously serene. We have sent the honored friends that they may acquaint themselves with your condition. In these days the chill of autumn hath prevailed over the heat of summer; the season for seclusion in the house hath arrived, and the time for turning one's steps toward the wilderness and for strolling in the open fields hath passed. Attendance in the divine Presence and return unto the primal Refuge are more meet and more beloved. May Diya abide with splendor.

O Badiʿ! Thy place is empty. A little bread hath been sent; partake thereof. Samadiyyih, God willing, will set out for the divine quarter. Khahib and Dilʿ-i-Vada should remain occupied in service.

Glory be upon you.

## BH09273: God willing, the fire of separation shall, through… {.unnumbered}

God willing, the fire of separation shall, through the blessed Word, be transmuted for them into coolness and peace, and the fire of the divine Lote-Tree shall so seize them that every dweller in repose will be stirred to movement, every smouldering one kindled into flame, and every rigid thing melted and set flowing.

He, verily, is potent to do whatsoever He willeth, and He is the mindful, the compassionate, the gracious. At such times as thou wert in the precincts of the mansion, thou wert observed, and likewise in the prison, standing over against the gate. Their condition remaineth even as it was. With an eye that slumber seizeth not, he beheld and observed.

We send thee our greetings and magnify thee, and likewise those who have clung to the Most Firm Handle and held fast to the hem of the grace of God, the Lord of all worlds.

## BH09284: O God! In the darksome nights, upon the lofty… {.unnumbered}

O God! In the darksome nights, upon the lofty mountains, I remembered Thee and sang Thy praise. Thy remembrance kindled my soul, and the hope of beholding Thee quickened and renewed it. Though I would hide myself behind doors, Thou didst, by Thy power, make me manifest and deliver me into the hands of Thy tyrannical servants. O Thou Who art mighty over the powerless, forgive and bestow Thy grace.

O God! Thy lover hath declared: At dawn, beneath the olive trees, I remembered Thee; from every branch and leaf I heard Thy voice. Whensoever I sought nearness unto Thee, Thou gavest me no reply. I passed beyond palaces in remembrance of Thy humble abode, and hastened unto the sheepfolds in memory of Thy Word. The movement of the shadows of the boughs laid hold on me, and the murmuring of the breeze of morn enraptured me. This attraction and this fervor have proceeded from Thee.

## BH09299: O My Well-Beloved! Thou hast breathed Thy Breath into… {.unnumbered}

O My Well-Beloved! Thou hast breathed Thy Breath into Me, and divorced Me from Mine own Self. Thou didst, subsequently, decree that no more than a faint reflection, a mere emblem of Thy Reality within Me be left among the perverse and envious. Behold, how, deluded by this emblem, they have risen against Me, and heaped upon Me their denials! Uncover Thy Self, therefore, O My Best-Beloved, and deliver Me from My plight.

Thereupon a Voice replied:

> "I love, I dearly cherish this emblem. How can I consent that Mine eyes, alone, gaze upon this emblem, and that no heart except Mine heart recognize it? By My Beauty, which is the same as Thy Beauty! My wish is to hide Thee from Mine own eyes: how much more from the eyes of men!"

I was preparing to make reply, when lo, the Tablet was suddenly ended, leaving My theme unfinished, and the pearl of Mine utterance unstrung.

## BH09314: Say: O party of God! Spend your precious life… {.unnumbered}

Say: O party of God! Spend your precious life in service to the Cause.

In every land the friends must consult together and appoint someone from among the people of that land for the purpose of teaching. Through an intermediary whose identity remains concealed and unspecified, they should provide the teacher with sufficient means to meet his needs, so that he may, with complete assurance, summon the servants to the horizon of divine favor. And that soul must be adorned with the ornament of wisdom and be aware of the disposition of those who are near to God and sincere.

Say: O party of God! Count time as precious, know the value of this divine Day. Help your Lord and He will help you through His grace. He is, verily, the Counselor, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH09326: Would that that subtle essence of the soul don… {.unnumbered}

He is God

Would that that subtle essence of the soul don garments of the hoopoe and journey to the Sheba of the Beloved, and that pure spirit be adorned with the vestment of glad tidings that it may return to the spiritual Canaan, and that rarefied being be sanctified from the manifestations of heedlessness that it may raise its head from the collar of love and passion and soar in the heaven of longing on wings of divine glory until it steps into the city of the Friend's ardor, and casts its head upon the vast wilderness of love, and sacrifices its soul in the path of the Beloved, that it may be guided by the Countenance of guidance and become independent of all save the Beauty of the Friend and enter the stream of immortality and attain to the ethereal reality of the Desired One.

## BH09389: Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! Praise be… {.unnumbered}

Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! Praise be to Thee for having revealed Thyself and for having made manifest that which had lain hidden within Thy knowledge and treasured within the repository of Thine infallibility; for having sent down unto Thy servants, from the heaven of Thy bounty, Thy proof and Thy testimony, and for having made known unto them Thy path. I beseech Thee, by the lights of the Day-Star of Thy bestowal in Thy days, and by the surging waves of the ocean of Thy grace amidst Thy servants, to make this servant steadfast in Thy Cause and eloquent in Thy praise.

O Lord! I am Thy servant. I bear witness unto that which is with Thee, and confess that which the Tongue of Thy grandeur hath uttered. I beseech Thee, O Thou Fruit of the Tree of Thy utterance, to illumine the hearts of Thy loved ones with the lights of Thy knowledge in that seat wherein Thou hast established Thyself upon the throne of Thy mercy and the seat of Thy gifts and loving-kindness.

Then kindle, O my God, within my breast the lamp of Thy love, that I may find no rest in myself, but may tremble at the stirring of the winds of Thy will; that I may speak of naught save Thy praise, move not except by Thy leave, and turn not save toward Thy presence. Thou, verily, art powerful to do whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the Most Exalted, the Almighty, the Mighty, the Chosen One.

## BH09391: Glorified art Thou, O my God! This is Thy… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Glorious

Glorified art Thou, O my God! This is Thy servant who hath heard Thy call, and been drawn by Thy verses, and been set ablaze with the fire of Thy love, and become occupied with Thy remembrance. The veils of glory have not prevented him from beholding the beauty of Thy oneness, nor have the shrouds of allusion obscured his vision from witnessing the signs of Thy unity and the evidences of Thy singleness. O Lord! Having guided him to the sweet spring of Thy mercy and given him to drink from the cups of Thy love, send upon him at all times the breezes of the Spirit from the direction of Thy divine oneness, aid him with Thy confirmations, assist him in every matter, and make him steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy remembrance. Verily Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful, the Glorious, the Beloved.

## BH09431: The page of writing which betokened and testified… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Exalted, the Most Great.

The page of writing which betokened and testified to the gladness of the tablet of the heart hath been received, and that which the pen of love had inscribed and traced thereon was observed. Praise be to God, ye have drunk from the choice wine of divine love. This is that wine, the mention whereof hath been set down in the heavenly Books. Blessed art thou, and blessed are they that have attained.

We beseech God to guide all unto the Most Great Ocean, and not to deprive His servants of this Most Great Bestowal and this supreme gift. He is, verily, the All-Bountiful.

Convey, from the tongue of this Wronged One, loving greetings unto the presence of Jinab-i-Aqa Muhammad-Baqir—upon him be the glory of God. We beseech God to assist him and to make him of those who have known and have remained steadfast. Verily He is the Guardian of them that turn unto Him.

Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

## BH09471: God hath heard that thou hast taken up residence… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ever-Abiding

God hath heard that thou hast taken up residence in a new place and established thyself in a wondrous station. By God! How excellent is your station in the most exalted Paradise and your seat within the all-glorious pavilion! We beseech God to sanctify your hearts from the mention of aught else but Him, to purify your station from all that His good-pleasure abhorreth, to aid you to remain firm in His love and to arise to serve Him, to bless this wondrous station for you, and to send down upon you that which is best for you. Verily, He is most knowing of all matters and their outcome. We have sent thee an apple that thou mayest inhale from it the fragrance of the Beloved and the breath of the Adored One. Share thou this among thy brothers, and in this sharing be praiseworthy and just, and be not an rejected oppressor.

## BH09515: Say: O ye loved ones of God, and His… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

Say: O ye loved ones of God, and His companions, and His party! Verily I declare: the distress of the loved ones hath itself been, and still is, the greatest cause and the mightiest instrument for the revelation of the kingdom of wealth and affluence amidst the people of Bahá. Today the glory of the faithful consisteth in the laying down of arms and in the betterment of the world, and not in the possession of all the gold and silver of the earth. Unto this bear witness they that are detached within the Kingdom of God, the Lord of the mighty Throne.

Say: Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the light of Thy justice, and by the fire of the Lote-Tree of Thy Cause, and by the mysteries that lay hidden within Thy knowledge, to ordain for me that which shall draw me nigh unto Thee, exalt me through Thy Name, and aid me through Thy bounty and Thy hosts. Thou art, verily, the Mighty, the All-Bounteous.

## BH09518: The Most Exalted Pen is occupied with the remembrance… {.unnumbered}

He is God.

The Most Exalted Pen is occupied with the remembrance of the friends, and saith: O loved ones! The ocean of inner meanings streameth and floweth forth from Me, and from its murmuring this blessed word is heard: Hasten, hasten! Come, come! Yet come with the heart, and not with the feet; for the feet may in an hour traverse but a stony path, whereas the heart, in a single instant, can cleave the distance of both worlds.

Nevertheless, that outward foot which in these days hath crossed the stages and valleys of separation and entered upon the shore of the sea of reunionâ€"blessed is that step, more excellent than all that hath been, and than all journeys. So hath it been been ordained.

## BH09541: What is it that the Book saith? What doth… {.unnumbered}

He is the Almighty, the Most Great.

What is it that the Book saith? What doth it utter? It giveth tidings. Glorified be God! Can it speak without a tongue? Yea: every created thing hath been transformed. The rock itself crieth aloud; the Pen maketh mention of the Lord of eternity.

And what, in the end, hath the Book declared? It hath declared this: that a true lover, from the city of lovers, hath set his face toward the place of pilgrimage and the scene of vision, and that after attaining the Presence he turneth unto this station.

When this most exalted word was made manifest, the inmates of Paradise and the denizens of heaven strove with one another in hastening forth to offer welcome.

A hundred thousand blessings rest upon those souls who attained, and beheld.

## BH09555: The Tongue of Grandeur proclaimeth, and the Hand… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the Great.

The Tongue of Grandeur proclaimeth, and the Hand of Power taketh, bestoweth, and conferreth; and the Most Great Ocean vouchsafeth, in its bounty, blessings past all reckoning. Blessed is the soul that hath attained thereunto and been illumined by the lights of the Day-Star of Revelation.

Render thanks unto the Desire of the world, in that He guided thee, confirmed thee, delivered thee from the darkness of vain imaginings and idle fancies, and illumined thee through the effulgent splendors of the lights of the Sun of Certitude. Thou didst attain, and behold, and hear. This indeed is the sovereign of all bounties and the lord of all stations.

Implore of God the preservation of this most exalted station and this most lofty rank. Verily, He is the Powerful, the Almighty.

## BH09577: We beseech God—blessed and exalted be He… {.unnumbered}

He is the Desired One, the Well-Beloved.

We beseech God—blessed and exalted be He—to act through you upon the cities of hearts and souls, and to manifest through you that which was hidden within His knowledge and veiled from eyes and sight.

The reply to your questions, in detail, was formerly revealed and dispatched. We beseech God once again to preserve you, to aid you, and to make manifest through you that which was concealed. A full and ample reply, in the Most Glorious manner, hath likewise been revealed and sent. Deliver it. Several letters have arrived from Íran; they too have been forwarded. Deliver the friends' reply, that they may rejoice and be of the thankful.

O Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and My loving care. Convey also the blessings; and we ask the True One to grant that which shall be the means and the cause of the manifestations of My grace and My loving-kindness.

## BH09585: This is the Book of God, sent down… {.unnumbered}

He is the Ever-Abiding.

This is the Book of God, sent down from the realm of exalted holiness; therein is mentioned that whereby the outcry of all contingent beings is raised unto the heaven of a radiant glory.

O Pen of Eternity! Make mention of her who hath ascended into the air of nearness and entered the pavilion of holiness in a station illumined with glory.

O handmaid of God! Soar thou within this Ridvan; then give thanks unto thy Lord, in that He hath effaced from thee thy sins, clothed thee with the garment of forgiveness before the concourse of Ridvan, and singled thee out to draw nigh unto the neighbourhood of the mercy of thy Lord.

Thus hath the bounty of thy Master encompassed all who are in the kingdom, one and all. And the Spirit be upon thee, and upon every steadfast and upright soul.

## BH09600: The Exalted Leaf and Mahd-i-ʿUlya—God willing—may they be joyful… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

The Exalted Leaf and Mahd-i-ʿUlya—God willing—may they be joyful, sound, and in good health. Affairs here, praise be to God, are well. Khanum hath improved, and the fever hath not returned. Our hope is that she may attain unto complete recovery.

Word hath been received that His honor Badi'u’llah hath shown some slight indisposition of temperament; as to the details, he himself should write them.

The statement of the expenses of the date-palms arrived and was sent on. Let them receive the money and preserve it until its disposition be commanded.

I convey greetings unto them all, and I beseech God to grant success unto each and every one. Verily, He is powerful over all things.

Peace and glory be upon you, O people of the household, and upon those who have attained the honor of serving you.

## BH09643: O Aqa Khan! Hear My call from the direction… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him through Whom the gate of bounty was opened to the world!

O Aqa Khan! Hear My call from the direction of My prison. Verily it hath been raised in such wise that both East and West have been blessed by hearkening unto it, through the loving-kindness of God, the Compassionate, the Generous. We have manifested that which was hidden in knowledge and have sent down that which hath brought solace to the eyes of all who are in the heavens and on earth. Be thankful unto God for this Most Great Remembrance which hath descended from the heaven of the loving-kindness of thy Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Say: All praise be unto Thee, O God of Names, and all glory be unto Thee, O Lord of all creation, for having remembered me when I was wronged and imprisoned in the hands of the heedless. And this was sent down for Isma'il, upon him be the glory of God.

## BH09660: O Diya! Upon thee be My glory. Thy request… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing.

O Diya! Upon thee be My glory. Thy request is understood; yet it is better and more pleasing that thou shouldst remain in thine own attire. Take the sunshade and leave the kifaya—leave the Arab garments for the Arabs. God willing, mayest thou, beneath the shadow of the divine favor, ever and always abide in joy and fragrance. Glory be upon thee.

As to the condition of the wife, the lady, Munirih, the mother, the children, and the handmaids of God who have endured hardship on account of the milk, or who are present for the sake of service—we send loving greetings unto them all.

Say unto Mustafa: Whatsoever appeareth with outward show shall in the end be lost and vanish away; and whatsoever cometh into view shall, at last, diminish. What son of man is there that did not sink into the dust? And what world is there that remained untouched by change? Grieve not; leave unto it its gauds and trappings.

## BH09700: O Muqbil! Forget not the bounty of God upon… {.unnumbered}

He is the Compassionate, the Help-in-Need.

O Muqbil! Forget not the bounty of God upon thee. He hath ordained for thee the good of the life to come and of this present life, and hath granted thee to attain His presence—a gift beyond compare with all the records of the nations. All affairs are in the grasp of His power; they behold it not, yet He bestoweth His loving care. Be thou occupied with thanksgiving for His blessings and be assured through His favour. Remember the days when thou wast in the presence of the Countenance and didst hear the call of God, the All-Subduing, the Self-Subsisting.

We beseech the True One to strengthen thee, that thou mayest be confirmed in that whose traces shall remain and endure upon the earth. Verily, He is the All-Powerful, mighty through His Name, the Omnipotent, worthy of His loving care.

Glory be upon thee, and upon every steadfast and upright soul.

## BH11680: This is a clear Book which hath been sent… {.unnumbered}

He is God

This is a clear Book which hath been sent down unto Amin, who hath believed in the Day of Judgment and hath walked the path of certitude. O Amin! Were there to be in thy right hand a cup of the water of life, set it down, then proclaim the Cause of thy Lord with wisdom and utterance, that the effulgence of the Sun of thy Lord's mercy may be shed upon all created things.

Say: O people of the earth! By God, the heart of the world hath been set ablaze by the call of your Lord, the All-Merciful. What aileth you that ye are not set ablaze? Ye behold and recognize, yet deny and remain ignorant. Those who dwell in the realms of the seen and the unseen are bewildered at you.

Convey My greetings unto My loved ones, that the fragrance of thy Lord's glorification may be wafted abroad and may draw unto it their hearts and the hearts of all who turn unto Him. Praise be to Him Who is the Beloved of them that know.

## BH11913: Rejoice within thyself for thine own self, then whisper… {.unnumbered}

He is God, the Most High, the Most Exalted!

Rejoice within thyself for thine own self, then whisper secretly unto thine essence within thine essence. Then detach thyself from all that hath been created in the past or will be created in the future, that thy heart may be sanctified from the intimations of grandeur, that the lights of holiness and beauty may be shed upon thee. Thus did We counsel thee aforetime, and now We cast it upon thee—act thou upon it. Be not of them who bar men from the path of God and prevent the servants from entering the ways of guidance, while imagining themselves to be rightly guided.

Convey Our greetings unto him who was with thee and whom We have loved with a love that no mention nor utterance can contain. Peace be upon him who followeth guidance.

## BH10060: In My Name, through which the sea surged… {.unnumbered}

In My Name, through which the sea surged and the fragrance was diffused!

O Ba', upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of the Kingdom of Names! Jinab-i-Haydar hath repeatedly made mention of the friends. Praise be to God, thou hast attained unto the pearls of the ocean of utterance of the Goal of all the worlds. Say:

My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having given me to drink the wine of Thy love from the hand of Thy bounty. I beseech Thee by Thy mercy which hath preceded all existence, both seen and unseen, to ordain for me that which shall profit me in every world of Thy worlds. Verily, Thou art the Hearer, the Answerer. There is none other God but Thee, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

## BH10041: O My Afnan, upon thee rest My Glory, My… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted is He in might and power

O My Afnan, upon thee rest My Glory, My Bounty and My Mercy! Verily, the Servant in Attendance came and made mention of thee in Our presence. We therefore extolled thee in such wise as to cause the cities of remembrance and utterance to be set ablaze. Verily thy Lord is the Supreme Ruler over all things. We have named thee, at this moment, Nuri'd-Din. We beseech God that He may ordain for thee that which will draw thee near unto Him and be of profit to thee. He verily is the All-Gracious, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

## BH10040: O Ism-i-Jud! Concerning the loved ones, it hath been… {.unnumbered}

O Ism-i-Jud! Concerning the loved ones, it hath been written that Jinab-i-Ibn-i-Abhar is occupied in service, and that Fadil, praise be to God, is in good health. Know this well, and be of them that render thanks.

Were the veil to be lifted, thou wouldst behold that which no eyes have seen. By the might of God and His greatness! This Wronged One desireth not to dwell among the people—unto this beareth witness the Dayspring of My Name, the Self-Subsisting.

Sorrow hath befallen the aforementioned soul. We beseech God that He may change it into joy. In all matters We have been with him and shall continue to be with him. Verily, He is the Almighty, the Best-Beloved.

Light, spirit, and glory rest upon him and upon those who are with him.

## BH09805: This most exalted perfect Word has at this moment… {.unnumbered}

He is God, blessed and exalted is He!

This most exalted perfect Word has at this moment been sent down from the divine Kingdom of Command:

O Ibn-i-Asdaq the Most Holy! Return to the land of Kha by command of God, the Lord of all humanity. We have heard the call of My loved ones and have answered what they desired, and verily I am the Hearer, the Answerer. Adorn the head of acceptance with the crown of detachment and the temple of existence with the fear of God, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Give glad tidings to the loved ones of the bounty of God, glorified be His majesty, and illumine their hearts with the light of My wondrous utterance. The glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of My mercy be upon thee and upon them and upon every steadfast and firm one.

## BH09727: From the gentle breezes of dawn wafting… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

From the gentle breezes of dawn wafting from the gardens of inner meanings, this most exalted Word was heard:

> "Blessed is he who remains steadfast whom the doubts of the divines have not deterred, and blessed is he who stands firm whom the tyranny of rulers has not held back."

O friend, give glad-tidings to the people of Baha. This is the day of supreme joy. All must arise to aid the Cause of God with spirit and fragrance. The helper today is deeds from which the sweet perfumes of acceptance waft, and in teaching there are signs for the knowing ones and evidences for those who hear. The glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of My loving-kindness be upon thee and upon every steadfast and upright one.

## BH10062: O Bashir! The Wronged One gives thee glad tidings… {.unnumbered}

He is the Helper, the All-Seeing

O Bashir! The Wronged One gives thee glad tidings of God's loving-kindness and grace, and makes mention of thee in that which shall cause thy name and remembrance to endure in My Mighty Book. We counsel thee and those who have believed to practice righteousness and the fear of God, and that whereby the Word of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, shall be exalted. Despair not of the Spirit of God and His mercy. Verily He guideth His detached servants. His mercy and His power have preceded all things, and His grace hath encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth. Glory be to God! Authority is God's! Sovereignty is God's, the Almighty, the All-Powerful! Thus hath My Most Exalted Pen spoken at this moment as a token of grace from Me, and I am indeed the All-Bountiful, the Ever-Generous.

## BH10066: O Haji Muhammad-Baqir! You have attained to the visitation… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

O Haji Muhammad-Baqir! You have attained to the visitation of the House and to the recognition of the Lord of the House, and this word, which is greater in the sight of God than heaven and earth, hath been revealed especially for you. Art thou able to thank Him as befitteth? Say: No, by Thy sovereignty, except through Thy pure, holy, mighty and wondrous tongue.

O my Lord! I have turned with my whole being unto Thee and have desired from the heaven of Thy bounty and the ocean of Thy generosity that which will cause me to soar in the atmosphere of Thy will and to act according to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Book, and to take hold of Thy Sealed Wine through Thy Self-Subsisting Name, and to drink thereof once through Thy Name and again through Thy mighty and beloved remembrance.

## BH10004: Your letter was received and its contents noted… {.unnumbered}

Your letter was received and its contents noted. For a time, due to lack of means, the sending of a reply was delayed....

...the world hath no worth or station in the sight of God, and both its hardship and ease are fleeting. We hope that outward means will also be made available, for the divine favors have ever encompassed and continue to encompass all from every direction. The duty of these servants is steadfastness and to walk in the path of His good-pleasure. Whatever else may come to pass is beloved, as they have said: "Everything from the Beloved is beloved," and in Arabic it is said: "The blow of the Beloved is as sweet as raisins."...

## BH10010: O My Nabíl! Upon thee be My glory, My… {.unnumbered}

O My Nabíl! Upon thee be My glory, My mercy, My bounty and My loving care. I bear witness that thou hast never halted in this Cause whereof the Books of God, the Lord of all the worlds, have heralded the glad-tidings; that in His days thou hast been a speaker, voicing the remembrance of God and His praise; and that thou hast inscribed that which God hath adorned with the raiment of acceptance. Verily, He is the Mighty, the All-Loving.

Blessed art thou, and blessed thy tongue, and blessed every steadfast and upright soul. God willing, thou wilt be aided to attain unto supreme constancy in this Most Great Announcement, and wilt continue to remind the servants of that which draweth them nigh unto the One, the All-Informed.

Glory be upon thee, and upon such as hearken unto thy words in this manifest, mighty and wondrous Cause.

## BH11852: O friend! Hearken to the Word of the Friend… {.unnumbered}

O friend! Hearken to the Word of the Friend and listen with thy soul. Grievous is it for the Friend to be separated from the friend, yet the Friend hath so desired. What befitteth the friend is submission to, and contentment with, the good-pleasure of the Friend. The Friend saith: "My friend, thou wilt surely love that which I love." Therefore, be thou content with the good-pleasure of the Friend and with whatsoever proceedeth from Him.

O friend! The cause of motion is heat, and the cause of ascension is lightness. God willing, the fire of the love of God which is deposited in thy verses will become the cause of ascension and the reason for motion, and will unite the friends with the friends.

## BH09774: We adorn the head of the Tablet… {.unnumbered}

He is God, exalted be His station, the Bestower of gifts and favors

We adorn the head of the Tablet with the remembrance and praise of God and bear witness that there is none other God but Him. He hath created the Afnan to serve His Cause and exalt His Word. And We bear witness that thou, O My Afnan and Leaf of My Divine Lote-Tree, didst leave thy homeland seeking the Most Exalted Homeland until thou didst arrive in Paradise and heard the call of the Most Glorious God and beheld the horizon of Revelation, a bounty from the One Who conversed on Sinai. Blessed art thou and joy be unto thee for having attained His presence and beheld that which was inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Books of God, the Lord of all worlds.

## BH09757: O handmaiden of God! Take comfort in God… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting!

O handmaiden of God! Take comfort in God and His remembrance, then detach thyself from all that hath been created in the heavens and on earth, for it shall perish, and what endureth is the remembrance of God, the Single, the One, the All-Powerful, the Almighty. Then turn thy face toward Him in all conditions and look not unto what hath been ordained in the contingent world. Place thy trust in the Ancient Beauty of Glory, for this is a mighty counsel. This is better for thee than all that hath been and shall be created, and verily thy Lord is the All-Seeing, the All-Knowing. And mercy be upon thee and upon those women who have turned their faces toward the countenance of God, the Most High, the Most Great.

## BH09776: He is the Caller at the heart of creation… {.unnumbered}

He is the Caller at the heart of creation: Unto Me, unto Me, O gems of the world in the kingdom of man!

I beseech Thee, O my God, turning toward the Kingdom of Thy Divinity, supplicating to the Heaven of Thy Mercifulness, clinging to the hem of Thy Singleness, imploring the glory of Thy Self-Subsistence, prostrate upon the dust in humility and submission, entreating Thy favors and loving-kindness, to look upon Thy sincere servants with the eyes of Thy mercy. Cast upon them the mantle of Thy light, make them steadfast in Thy Cause, and render them the dawning-places of Thy signs and the daysprings of Thy spirit and Thy fragrances, yearning for the sweetness of bearing tribulations in Thy path in such wise that nothing shall prevent them from Thy mention and praise. Verily, Thou art the All-Kind, the All-Merciful.

## BH09807: For protection, a Most Exalted, Most Mighty, Most Glorious… {.unnumbered}

For protection, a Most Exalted, Most Mighty, Most Glorious da'ira in the handwriting of Mirza Aqa Jan has been sent for your honor and Shams Shama Haji. God willing, they will be preserved from all calamities and afflictions under divine protection.

And in these days, God willing, a letter will be sent for Haji, your recent namesake, and others, but it was not possible by post. And regarding others, concerning the matter of [unclear] Aqa Mirza [unclear] that was written, it has been recommended that he send the receipt to your honor, and if you deem it advisable, send this matter along with the matter you had written about by post.

## BH09844: Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Giving, the Generous

Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy favors which the pens of the world are powerless to recount, and by Thy gifts which the hearts of nations confess are beyond limitation, and by the Light wherewith the Mount was illumined when it shone forth from the horizon of the will of the Lord of Manifestation, to bless the steps of Thy handmaiden whom Thou hast named Neshat-Angiz by Thy wondrous and mighty Pen among Thy chosen ones and loved ones. Then make her a sign of Thy mercy among Thy handmaidens and a manifestation of Thy grace among Thy creatures. Verily, Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever Thou willest through Thy Name, the All-Encompassing over all names. There is no God but Thee, the Powerful, the All-Bountiful, the Generous.

## BH09853: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Preserve Thou… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty, the Everlasting, the Glorious, the All-Glorious!

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Preserve Thou Thy loved ones who have sought to attain Thy presence and to visit Thy Beauty, and who have therefore traversed the paths of land and sea in heat and cold. Among them are those who, after their yearning, were cast into prison, and among them are those who died in separation. I beseech Thee then, O my God, by that Name of Thine whereby Thou hast encompassed all things with Thy knowledge, to ordain for all things the reward of attaining Thy presence and the station of reunion with Thee, that nothing in the heavens or on the earth or in between them may be deprived of the sovereignty of Thy bestowals. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things.

## BH09893: God testifieth that there is none other God but… {.unnumbered}

He is God, the Most Great

In the Name of God, the Eternal, Who changeth not

God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life by the sovereignty that is with Him. He, verily, is the One, the All-Compelling. Blessed is he who hath rent asunder the veils through this Name whereby God hath subdued all who are in the heavens and on earth. Say: The proof hath come from the presence of the All-Merciful. Blessed is the strong one who hath, through His Name, rent asunder the veils of idle fancies. The Pen hath been forbidden to mention that which it desired. Were God to will it, there would appear from it that which would cause the hearts of the righteous to take flight. Be thou grateful unto God for having ordained for thee a portion in the Book.

## BH09911: Know that the Bird hath flown from the branch… {.unnumbered}

He is the Mighty One

Know that the Bird hath flown from the branch of Iraq by reason of that which the hands of the oppressors have wrought, yet matters have been so ordained that ere long the loved ones of God shall be honored in all lands. Praise be to God, all enemies shall be brought low. No longer will it be as before, when they were rejected by all governments. Now it hath come to pass that all seek them. God willing, the fruits thereof shall appear. And if harm hath touched this one, this is God's way that hath operated of old. In any case, I remember all the sisters and family members. Let them not make verjuice—there is plenty of lemon juice.

## BH09935: The Beauty of God hath appeared with sovereign majesty… {.unnumbered}

He is the Most Manifest

The Beauty of God hath appeared with sovereign majesty, and blessed art thou, O handmaiden of God, that thou dost become illumined by His effulgence. The Face of God hath dawned with mighty power, and blessed art thou, O handmaiden of God, that thou dost become enlightened by His lights. The Manifestation of the Cause hath come with the dominion of might and power, and blessed art thou, O handmaiden of God, that thou dost become radiant from His radiance. The Revealer of divine revelation and inspiration hath come with the kingdom of signs, and blessed art thou, O handmaiden of God, that thou dost receive from His revelations. And mercy be upon thee and upon whosoever hath believed in God and acknowledged His signs.

## BH10020: Those souls who considered themselves the most learned, distinguished… {.unnumbered}

Those souls who considered themselves the most learned, distinguished and accomplished were not and are not mentioned in the presence of God. By the life of God! If the veil were lifted, those who turned away would circle around those who turned towards God, and would flock from all directions to attain their presence and meeting. However, consummate wisdom has concealed this, so that there might be manifested from them in His days what was hidden within them and stored in their inmost beings. This blessed verse has ever been inscribed at the head of the book of deeds by the Most Exalted Pen:

> "Do men think that they will be left alone on saying, ʿWe believe,' and will not be tested?"

## BH10032: To Him belongs the invisible essence of the heavens… {.unnumbered}

He is God!

To Him belongs the invisible essence of the heavens and the earth, and none shall ever attain to His mystery, neither the denizens of the pavilions of immortality nor the concourse of the realm of the divine cloud. He has ever dwelt in the treasury of His mystery in the identity of His Essence, and will ever continue to be, not as He was before but rather He was and will be sanctified above all that has been or will be created, and above all that was or will be. Verily He is the Hidden Mystery, and He through His own Self, the Mystery, hath testified that He is He, there is no God but He, the Impenetrable, the Inaccessible, the Hidden Mystery.

## BH10046: O My handmaiden! Upon thee be My glory… {.unnumbered}

He is the Forgiving!

O My handmaiden! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness! Thy letter was sent to the Most Holy Court. Praise be to God that the fragrance of sincerity and recognition of God, exalted be His glory, wafted therefrom [inimitably]. A single letter from His presence surpasses all that hath been created on earth. I counsel thee and the handmaidens of God to that which beseemeth His Day and His Manifestation. I beseech God, exalted be His glory, to adorn all with the light of detachment and the crown of righteousness. Convey My greetings to the handmaidens in that land. Each soul mentioned in thy letter hath attained to the remembrance of the Wronged One. Well is it with you and pleasant it is for you.

## BH10056: O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One!… {.unnumbered}

He is the One Who calls out in truth!

O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One! Thy letter which thou didst send to Asad, upon him be My glory, hath been honored with My attention. We have heard thy call and have answered thee with words whereby the hearts of them that are nigh have been drawn. We beseech God to make thee a standard of His name among the world and its peoples. He, verily, is the Almighty, the All-Powerful. Blessed art thou for having been faithful to the Covenant and preserved the love of God and His testament in thy heart. He will assuredly assist thee and those who have turned unto Him and responded when the Call was raised between the heavens and the earth. Convey My greetings to the faces of My loved ones from whom the fragrance of steadfastness hath been wafted in this Great Announcement. Say: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who art the Goal of the worlds!

## BH10093: O ʿAli before Muhammad! Upon thee be the peace… {.unnumbered}

He is the Helper, the All-Knowing.

O ʿAli before Muhammad! Upon thee be the peace of God, the Single, the One. We have mentioned thee before, and at this time with a mention whose fragrance will not cease throughout the duration of the names of God, the Lord of those in the heavens and earths. Say:

My God, my God! And glory be unto Thee, O my God, my Adored One and my Goal! I beseech Thee by Him through Whose advent the celestial spheres were honored and the heaven was adorned, to open before my face the doors of Thy mercy and Thy bestowal and Thy grace and Thy wealth. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is no God but Thee, the All-Bountiful, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

## BH10134: O our God, we beg of Thee… {.unnumbered}

O our God, we beg of Thee by the King of Names and Maker of heaven and earth, by the rustling of the leaves of the Tree of Life and by Thine utterances, through which the realities of things are drawn unto us, to grant that the unity in the Love of God may be speedily established throughout the world; that Thou wilt guide us always and unmistakably to whatever Thou wouldst have us to do, and that we may ever be strong and fully prepared to render instant, exact and complete obedience.

## BH10137: The Day of the Promise is come, and He… {.unnumbered}

The Day of the Promise is come, and He Who is the Promised One loudly proclaimeth before all who are in heaven and all who are on earth, ʿVerily there is none other God but He, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting!' I swear by God! That which had been enshrined from eternity in the knowledge of God, the Knower of the seen and unseen, is revealed. Happy is the eye that seeth, and the face that turneth towards, the Countenance of God, the Lord of all being....

## BH10138: O Lord, deliver us from all temptations, tests… {.unnumbered}

O Lord, deliver us from all temptations, tests and evil suggestions of those who turned their faces from Thee. O Thou merciful God, confirm us by Thine invisible hosts and reinforce us through Thy heavenly angels.

O Lord, we are weak, poor, submissive and humble; strengthen, enrich and uplift us above all earthly conditions.

O God! As Thou hast illumined our hearts with the light of knowing Thee, make us firm in Thy Blessed Covenant.

Verily, Thou art the clement, the forgiving!

## BH11851: Thy verses, adorned with the ornament of divine love… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the Most Glorious!

Thy verses, adorned with the ornament of divine love, reached the hands of this lonely and evanescent exile. They brought joy to the hearts of these captives. Thy poetry became the cause of gladness to the heart of this secluded one, and thy prose brought about the banishment of the sorrows that had descended.

We have presented thy verses before the Countenance of the Throne, whereupon these sublime words were uttered:

> "O handmaid of God! In these days of grief, We have been cheered by thy poetry and gladdened by thy prose. Be thou patient in the hour of separation; God willing, thou shalt attain the bliss of reunion."

Continue, therefore, at all times to remember this captive, and remain steadfastly patient in thy longing. And the spirit rest upon thee and upon all the handmaids of God. And peace be upon thee.

## BH10225: Every soul must, in this day, ponder upon… {.unnumbered}

Every soul must, in this day, ponder upon that which hath been revealed, and investigate with his own understanding and discernment, lest he be deprived of the effulgent rays of the Sun of Truth. The True One hath ever been, and will continue to be, distinguished from all else. The opposition of those who turn away and the denial of those who reject have not, and never will, affect this truth. For in every age and century, when the Sun of Truth appeared, the divines, mystics and rulers rose up in opposition and exerted their utmost to extinguish the divine light....

## BH10471: O ʿAli! The world is manifesting hypocrisy, except… {.unnumbered}

He is the Supporter, the All-Knowing!

O ʿAli! The world is manifesting hypocrisy, except for those whom God has willed. Some souls have been prevented from the Luminary of the horizons—they cling to names while remaining deprived and forbidden from their Creator. We beseech God to illumine all with the light of true unity and sanctify them from all else besides Him. And we beseech God to ordain for the relatives of Zaynu'l-Muqarrabin, upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, that which is everlasting and eternal. Verily, He is powerful over all things.

## BH10278: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee… {.unnumbered}

In the Name of Him through Whom we have subdued the hearts!

Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name that hath dominion over all names, and by Thy signs whereby the realities of all things were drawn unto Thee, and by Thy mercy that hath preceded all who are in earth and heaven, and by the power of Thy Most Exalted Word, to open before the face of him who hath been named Abdul-Karim the gates of bounties and favors. O Lord! Thou seest him turning toward Thee and directing himself to the lights of Thy countenance. I beseech Thee to make him a banner of Thy Name amidst Thy creatures. Verily, Thou art God, the Powerful, the Dominant over all who are in the heavens and earths.

## BH10152: My God, my God! Thou seest me turning unto… {.unnumbered}

...My God, my God! Thou seest me turning unto Thee and clinging to the cord of Thy bounty. Ordain for me through Thy generosity that which Thou lovest and which pleaseth Thee. Verily Thou art the Lord of all beings and the Lord of the hereafter and the former worlds. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous....

My God, my God! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant. I have desired naught save Thy good-pleasure and have wished for naught except what Thou hast ordained for me through Thy bounty and generosity. I beseech Thee to preserve me from all that beseemeth not the heaven of Thy might and the ocean of Thy power, and to aid me to act according to what Thou hast commanded me in Thy Book. Verily Thou art the Possessor of all being and the Ordainer of the seen and the unseen....

## BH10411: He calleth out before the faces of all men {.unnumbered}

He calleth out before the faces of all men

O son of My Afnan! O thou who speakest My Name, who dwellest in My vicinity, and who drinkest the wine of My utterance! My Most Exalted Pen hath testified to thy presence, thy sincerity, and thy steadfastness in the Cord of God, the Most Strong. Say:

Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by the light of Thy Cause whereby the earth and heaven were illumined, to ordain for me what Thou hast ordained for such of Thy servants as are nigh unto Thee and for such of Thy creation as are sincere. Then send down upon me from the clouds of Thy bounty mercy and blessing from Thy presence. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

## BH10418: In My Name, the Remembering, the All-Knowing {.unnumbered}

In My Name, the Remembering, the All-Knowing

O My Afnan! Upon thee be My Glory and My loving-kindness. We beseech God to exalt thee through His Name and to open before thy face the door of His bounty and to aid thee with the hosts of His utterance. Verily, there is none other God but Him. He ordaineth as He pleaseth, and He is the Commander, the All-Knowing. The Glory be upon thee and upon My loved ones there who love thee for the sake of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Jinab-i-Ism-i-Jud, upon him be My Glory and My loving-kindness, was present and We heard from him mention of thee. We have remembered thee through this clear Book.

## BH10157: My God and my Beloved! This is Thy servant… {.unnumbered}

He is the All-Glorious!

My God and my Beloved! This is Thy servant who hath turned toward the sanctuary of Thy perpetuity, and who hath been set ablaze with the fire of Thy love, and who hath heard Thy call, and who hath detached himself unto Thee, hoping to enter into Thy Kingdom and to ascend unto the heaven of Thy grace and bounty. Therefore it behooveth Thy loftiness and Thy exaltation and Thy generosity and Thy munificence to assist him in this, O God of the worlds! For whoso turneth unto Thee and seeketh refuge with Thee—far be it from Thee, then far be it from Thee, to disappoint him or to deprive him of the droplets from the clouds of Thy favors and gifts, or to withhold from him the surging waves of the oceans of Thy grace and beneficence.

## BH10203: Be thou of the people of hell-fire, but be… {.unnumbered}

Be thou of the people of hell-fire, but be not a hypocrite.

Be thou an unbeliever, but be not a plotter.

Make thy home in taverns, but tread not the path of the mischief-maker.

Fear thou God, but not the priest.

Give to the executioner thy head, but not thy heart.

Let thine abode be under the stone, but seek not the shelter of the cleric.

Thus doth the Holy Reed intone its melodies, and the Nightingale of Paradise warble its song, so that He may infuse life eternal into the mortal frames of men, impart to the temples of dust the essence of the Holy Spirit and the heavenly Light, and draw the transient world, through the potency of a single word, unto the Everlasting Kingdom.
